jobs.excerpt: Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?
jobs.description:
Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um ecossistema de mais de 12 mil pessoas inconformadas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Atuamos como uma Única TOTVS, integrando diferentes soluções e expertises para educar o mercado e simplificar o mundo dos negócios. Para nós, a evolução é constante e acontece de gente para gente: usamos nossa inquietude para antecipar tendências e transformar o crescimento real da tecnologia.


Nosso jeito de ser:

🤖IH + IA (Inteligência Humana + Inteligência Artificial): Acreditamos que a tecnologia potencializa, mas as pessoas direcionam. Aqui, a IA nos dá escala e eficiência, enquanto a nossa Inteligência Humana traz a estratégia, o contexto e o cuidado. É essa combinação que nos permite criar soluções inovadoras com um propósito real.

🚀Protagonismo e Evolução: Somos movidos pelo aprendizado contínuo e pela coragem de assumir o comando da própria carreira. Aqui, incentivamos a inquietude e oferecemos o ambiente fértil para quem quer crescer, criar e se transformar.

Resultado Responsável: Valorizamos a liberdade para agir e a responsabilidade com o todo. Aqui, você tem voz para desafiar o status quo e autonomia para buscar resultados que gerem valor real para nossos clientes e para a sociedade.

🧘🏼‍♀️Bem-Estar Integral: Cuidamos de quem faz a evolução acontecer. Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

🫂Pluralidade e Pertencimento: A diversidade é o que nos torna potentes. Promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa, garantindo que a TOTVS seja um lugar onde você pode ser quem você é. Nossa expertise é humana e viva: acolhemos as diferenças para empoderar negócios dentro e fora da empresa.

Seu desafio no time:

A equipe de pré-vendas é responsável por identificar oportunidades de negócios em meio ao grande volume de leads que geramos todos os meses com nossas ações de marketing. Através de um processo de prospecção referência no mercado, você terá a oportunidade de conhecer um pouco mais sobre negócios de diferentes setores e entender quais são os principais desafios de empreendimentos de todo o país.
Você será responsável pelo primeiro contato da RD com potenciais clientes! É sua missão gerar valor sobre o que fazemos, durante todas as etapas do processo de vendas, aprimorando os aprendizados que surgem nessa jornada e melhorando ainda mais a experiência de quem quer conhecer a RD.

Construímos um time de pré-vendas de excelência, com playbooks e processos sólidos, visando garantir os melhores resultados! Você é movido pela paixão de superar desafios e metas constantemente? Adora interagir com pessoas de diversos segmentos para captar as principais tendências? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time e trabalhar com grandes referências do mercado em uma empresa brasileira em pleno crescimento e expansão! O seu lugar é aqui na RD 🚀

Para entender melhor a importância da área de Pré-vendas, veja este artigo do Blog da Resultados Digitais. Veja também nosso vídeo explicando melhor a job de Pré-vendas!

Suas principais entregas:

  • Identifica potenciais clientes por meio de qualificação e nutrição de leads;
  • A qualificação determina se os leads estão alinhados com os critérios ideais de cliente, avaliando suas a. dores, b. seu cenário, c. objetivo, d. seus investimentos, e. cronograma;
  • Fornecer feedbacks ao marketing sobre a qualidade dos leads, a eficácia das campanhas e as tendências de mercado para otimizar as estratégias de geração de leads;
  • Utilizar sistemas de CRM (Salesforce) para registro histórico, além de outras ferramentas para gerenciar e comunicar-se efetivamente com os leads;
  • Agendar reuniões de diagnóstico e apresentações entre os leads qualificados e Sales Representatives;

Perfil que buscamos:

  • Experiência prévia em pré-vendas ou vendas em empresas de tecnologia/SaaS, com atuação em processos mais consultivos e de diagnóstico aprofundado;
  • Vivência com estratégias multiproduto e entendimento de diferentes propostas de valor conforme o perfil do cliente;
  • Habilidade consultiva baseada em técnicas de vendas e playbooks, com boa capacidade de investigação, escuta ativa e condução de conversas mais longas (calls em média de 45 minutos);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de marketing e familiaridade com sistemas de CRM para gestão de leads, campanhas e histórico de interações;
  • Perfil organizado, com evidências claras de controle de pipeline, follow-ups e próximos passos, mesmo em um contexto onde volume não é o principal fator;
  • Conhecimento prático em metodologias de vendas, como SPIN Selling, demonstrando abordagem estruturada e consistente;
  • Compreensão das principais métricas de desempenho em vendas, como taxas de conversão, ciclo de vendas e tempo de rampa;
  • Experiência anterior como vendedor(a) ou atuação atual em fechamento é um diferencial relevante, pois tende a gerar maior aderência ao modelo do time;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, objetividade e capacidade de adaptação do discurso conforme o nível de maturidade do lead.;

Será considerado como um diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia em contextos de vendas mais complexas ou vendas via canais/parcerias;
  • Vivência em agências de marketing, especialmente lidando com diferentes perfis de clientes e demandas simultâneas;
  • Interesse genuíno em impulsionar negócios, com empatia na escuta, didática para explicar soluções e resiliência para lidar com desafios do dia a dia;
  • Vontade real de aprender e evoluir, buscando se aprofundar em produtos, estratégias de vendas e marketing;
  • Experiência ou cursos em Marketing Digital, Customer Success ou Inside Sales;
  • Formação em andamento ou concluída nas áreas de marketing, comercial, administração ou correlatas;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplos stakeholders e necessidade de adaptação constante;

Etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Aplicação: Envio da inscrição;
  • Mindsight: Teste de estilo de trabalho;
  • Talent Acquisition: Entrevista por competência com o time de recrutamento;
  • Entrevista Técnica: Entrevista técnica para discussão de requisitos da vaga;
  • Entrevista Final: Conversa final com a gerência para alinhamento;
  • Offer: Fase de conclusão do processo seletivo, com a apresentação da proposta de trabalho.

Obs: Podem ter etapas complementares e/ou alterações, de acordo com a necessidade do processo.brid

🔒 Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade, descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

Se você é uma pessoa movida por desafios, criatividade e impacto genuíno, avance conosco nessa jornada de evolução!

Faça parte do nosso time!

jobs.description:
Ministry Brands is looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our growing team!

 

Who we are

Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for faith-based, non-profit and for-profit organizations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades. The diverse and real-world experiences of our team members serving their communities makes us stronger together and enhances our ability to advance digital transformation for the greater good.   

  

Ministry Brands is committed to acknowledging and valuing our employee differences and to creating an environment in which every individual’s unique strengths and abilities are developed and valued. Our employees share in the responsibility for creating this environment and demonstrate mutual respect and acceptance in the workplace. We welcome everyone and are dedicated to creating a culture where all our employees have equal opportunity to be heard and reach their full potential.  

The following locations in the Southeast region are approved remote working locations for this role: Georgia, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Alabama, Mississippi, and Florida.

What you'll do:

As a Sales Development Representative you will be responsible for generating and qualifying leads, reaching out to prospective clients, and setting up meetings for the Account Executives. Your role is critical in driving the early stages of the sales funnel and contributing to the growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop pipeline by building interest with new prospects and clients resulting from your own outbound research and activities including email, phone and/or social media
  • Set meetings for sales team for product demonstrations with interested prospects (from both inbound leads and your own self-sourced leads)
  • Making a minimum of 40 calls a day, sending at least 10 personalized emails
  • Spending Admin time learning the product every week
  • Learning the multiple verticals across the business depending on the verticals you work
  • Asking for feedback in 1 on 1’s on how to keep improving
  • Work closely with marketing and sales teams to initiate the sales cycle with specific, targeted demand generation campaigns with prospects and current clients
  • Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of solutions and be able to clearly articulate the advantages over competitors
  • Meet monthly quotas for overall activity, demonstrations set & conducted, and qualified opportunity dollars
  • Utilize phone dialer tools with daily usage of 2 hours per day when making dials
  • Contribute to every component of the critical functions associated with fulfilling the sales cycle (forecasting, reporting, customer database maintenance, communications, etc.)  
  • Respond to all inbound leads and log activities in CRM
  • Working alongside AE’s to ensure SAOs resort into a Closed Won
  • Follow the GTM strategy for new and existing business

Who you are:

  • 1+ years of telemarketing or inside sales experience
  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • Experience selling in the tech industry, preferred
  • Adept with various technical systems
  • Microsoft Suite experience
  • A proven track record of successful prospect engagement  
  • Ability to manage multiple relationships
  • Ability to successfully hit at least 18 SAO (Sales Accepted Opportunities) per month
  • Attention to detail with excellent organization skills
  • Contagious positivity
  • Effective time management skills  
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral

Physical Considerations:

  • Ability to work in a general office environment
  • Ability to handle extended periods of computer-based work, including telephone

Travel Considerations:

  • Domestic and/or international travel required, estimated up to 5%

Benefit offerings designed to promote a life of balance!  
 

At Ministry Brands, we recognize that your career is just one important piece of your dynamic life. We offer a robust range of benefit offerings designed to cultivate a lifestyle of balance and personal success. 

 

Robust healthcare options – Employees have several healthcare options to choose from in order to find what works best for them. 

Flexible paid time off – There is no perfect, one size fits all balance between work and home. We provide flexible work schedules, PTO for vacation, and up to 80 hours of paid sick/safe leave. We also feature 11.5 days of fully paid holidays!  

Paid parental leave – Adding a new child to the family is a big adjustment! We provide the time and income to allow parents to adjust to their new normal in the healthiest way possible.  

Mental health support –Ministry Brands is a stigma free company with the National Alliance on Mental Illness. Associates are supported through an Employee Assistance Program which provides access to in-person or virtual counseling at no cost.  

Professional development reimbursement –Ministry Brands aims to support your professional development and empower you to drive your career by providing financial assistance to our associates seeking to further their education and career.

Employee Recognition & Rewards - At Ministry Brands, we use Nectar to celebrate achievements and strengthen our culture of recognition. This social platform empowers employees to send meaningful kudos, award points redeemable for rewards, and highlight contributions that exemplify our values. Through Nectar, we foster engagement and appreciation while providing tangible ways to recognize great work.

Ministry Brands is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: DRG Manager
jobs.excerpt: Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country.
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About the Opportunity

At Machinify, we’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry—creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize our clients’ financial outcomes today and drive down healthcare costs tomorrow. As part of the Complex Payment Solutions Team, you will, as the DRG Manager, be responsible for the development and management of our clinical solutions, including MS and APR-DRG validation. This role requires expertise in healthcare payment methodologies and audit and review criteria to target key claims for review and recovery. Key responsibilities include inventory and team management, implementation support, client support, research, and management. This role requires a proactive and strategic thinker with strong leadership and analytical skills to drive the success of our clinical solutions and ensure optimal team performance.

What you’ll do

  • Enhance and Review Clinical Solutions: Utilize expertise to assist in the enhancement and review of readmissions, place of service, and other clinical solutions.
  • Collaborative Development: Work with a multi-disciplinary team of programmers, operations staff, product leaders, and auditors to bring DRG process ideas from creation to implementation.
  • Regulatory Monitoring: Assess and adjust written rules by monitoring their effectiveness, keeping up with regulatory updates, and making necessary changes.
  • Team Leadership: Lead the DRG team by providing guidance, counsel, and development plans to ensure long-term retention and professional growth of DRG staff.
  • Claims Review Management: Oversee the entire process of clinical claims review, understanding various client configurations and workflows.
  • Operational Oversight: Manage scheduling, reporting to management, issue resolution, and execution of plans.
  • Work Coordination: Assign and prioritize work, set goals, and coordinate daily activities of the team. Provide regular updates and communication through one-on-one and team meetings.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor individual and team results to ensure timely completion of work in accordance with department standards and medical policy guidelines.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Demonstrate analytical skills to identify problems and trends, develop solutions, and implement action plans.
  • Policy and Process Development: Develop departmental policies, processes, and training standards.
  • Support and Evidence: Provide internal and external partners with evidence and references supporting industry standards, auditing guidelines, and review stances.
  • Performance Reporting: Provide reports on key performance indicators, including quality scores, workflows, savings, revenue projections, and inventory on a predetermined schedule.
  • Solution Development: Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team to suggest solution development, including operations, product, data analytics, and technology.
  • Timeline Management: Set timelines and ensure communication on progress, tracking delivery, and escalating roadblocks or dependencies.
  • Program Deployment: Design and deploy effective programs/solutions to identify and correct claims with aberrant results, providing feedback to resolve root causes.
  • Research and Special Projects: Assist with research, special projects, and ad hoc claim reviews as needed.
  • Other Duties: Perform other duties as assigned.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree (health administration, business, nursing)
  • Equivalent experience of 5+ years in healthcare billing and coding
  • Equivalent experience of 3+ years in claims auditing and recovery auditing
  • Proven experience working within a team, sharing DRG audit process knowledge with sales, marketing, and development teams
  • Proven knowledge of classification systems, including MSDRG, APR DRG, AP DRG, and outpatient payment systems such as APCs and EAPGs
  • Demonstrated curiosity and mastery in understanding the root cause of events and behaviors
  • Strong experience in data utilization and insights
  • Experience independently structuring and executing complex analyses
  • Familiarity with Milliman and InterQual guidelines
  • Expertise in DRG validation
  • Experience in production and team management
  • Experience with Readmission reviews
  • Ability to work efficiently and effectively with minimal supervision
  • High standards of quality and attention to detail
  • Deep understanding of Medicare and Commercial coding rules, regulations, and prospective payment systems
  • Superior knowledge of healthcare coding, billing, and reimbursement
  • Expert knowledge of clinical criteria documentation requirements
  • Subject matter expertise in APR-DRG validation, Readmissions, and Place of Service

What we offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
  • FSA/HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

Pay range: $125,000-$140,000 USD, plus annual bonus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is seeking an experienced Proposal Manager/Writer to join our Global Proposals Team as a key contributor supporting the development of proposals, questionnaires, and business development materials. The ideal candidate blends strong business writing with disciplined project management, has working knowledge of (or a strong appetite to learn) cloud security, and can quickly grasp the complexity of our market, our platform, and our customers' needs.

jobs.title: NBS Database Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Nelnet Business Services (NBS), a division of Nelnet, Inc.
jobs.description:
Nelnet Business Services (NBS), a division of Nelnet, Inc., provides payment technology and education services to more than 1,200 higher education institutions, nearly 12,000 K-12 schools, and millions of individual students, families, and supporters across the globe. Our culture of service enables us to form long-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive.

The NBS Database Administrator is a highly visible role with significant opportunity for technical growth and increasing ownership. This position plays a hands-on role in supporting and advancing the MongoDB Atlas environment behind a growing portfolio of NBS microservices. The person in this role will build deeper MongoDB and NoSQL expertise while helping support a platform that continues to expand in scale and importance.

The work goes well beyond routine database administration. This role works across the database lifecycle with responsibilities that include network access and security, backup and recovery, performance tuning, upgrades, capacity planning and production troubleshooting. The position works closely with development and technical teams to solve problems, improve performance and help keep application services reliable and available.

The MongoDB Atlas environment supports shared services used across the NBS product suite. It spans test, preview and production workloads with dozens of application databases, hundreds of collections and more than 1,000 indexes. The role also provides opportunities to gain experience with Redis, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance and supporting cloud technologies.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supports the day-to-day administration and operational health of MongoDB Atlas across production, test and preview environments.
  • Monitors MongoDB Atlas alerts and performance metrics. Reviews cluster health and resource utilization. Uses logs and monitoring tools to identify potential issues before they affect applications.
  • Assists with cluster performance and capacity management. Reviews workload trends, storage growth, cluster sizing and autoscaling behavior.
  • Analyzes query and index performance using MongoDB Atlas monitoring and diagnostic tools. Reviews slow-running operations, query plans and index utilization to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Works closely with development teams to investigate inefficient queries and application behavior. Helps evaluate indexes and tuning changes that improve MongoDB performance and stability.
  • Supports the administration of MongoDB databases, collections and indexes. Also manages users, roles, network access controls and security settings using established NBS standards.
  • Assists with MongoDB Atlas backup and restore activities. Supports point-in-time recovery, disaster recovery testing and recovery validation.
  • Supports MongoDB Atlas maintenance and platform changes. This includes upgrades, version changes, scaling events and configuration changes. Performs post-change validation to confirm platform health.
  • Participates in incident response and production troubleshooting. Uses database activity, application errors, logs and performance metrics to help identify root cause and restore service.
  • Troubleshoots application connectivity and database access issues. Works with development teams, application support and Cloud Operations when issues involve networking, authentication or supporting infrastructure.
  • Supports database security and access management. Assists with access requests, role assignments, permission changes and employee termination reviews. Follows least-privilege access standards.
  • Supports database change management processes. Reviews, tests and documents approved changes before implementation.
  • Participates in platform improvement work. Helps evaluate new MongoDB Atlas capabilities, automation opportunities and operational practices that can improve reliability or efficiency.
  • Assists with related data platforms including Redis, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL and Azure SQL Managed Instance. Responsibilities may include monitoring, maintenance, performance troubleshooting, backup and recovery, migrations and connectivity testing.
  • Documents procedures, configurations, troubleshooting steps and recurring support tasks. Records operational and incident findings to support team knowledge sharing.
  • Continues to build technical knowledge of MongoDB Atlas and related cloud database technologies. Develops deeper skills in query performance, indexing, security, monitoring, backup and recovery.

Salary range for this role is: $85,000-$107,500

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technology or a related field. Equivalent education and experience may be considered.

Preferred: Relevant database, cloud, MongoDB or technology-related certifications. Hands-on experience supporting database systems in a professional environment is also preferred.

EXPERIENCE

Five or more years of experience working with database systems, data platforms or related technical database environments is preferred. Experience supporting production or cloud-hosted database environments is especially valuable.

One or more years of hands-on experience with MongoDB or MongoDB Atlas is strongly preferred. Production MongoDB Atlas experience is especially valuable and will help a candidate become effective in the role more quickly.

Experience with relational database technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL or Azure SQL Managed Instance is beneficial. Experience with cloud platforms, monitoring tools or application troubleshooting is also valuable.

COMPETENCIES - SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES

  • Demonstrates curiosity and a strong desire to learn new database technologies, cloud platforms and business systems.
  • Takes initiative and ownership when investigating technical issues. Willing to dig into unfamiliar problems and follow them through to resolution.
  • Excited to build deeper expertise in MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas and NoSQL technologies.
  • Enjoys working as part of a collaborative technical team. Comfortable sharing knowledge, asking questions and learning from others.
  • Motivated by opportunities to grow technical skills and take on increasing levels of responsibility. Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills. Able to document technical findings and communicate issues clearly. Organized and detail-oriented with good time management and follow-through.
  • Strong understanding of database concepts. This includes databases, collections or tables, indexes, queries, security, backup and recovery.
  • Understanding of document-oriented and NoSQL database concepts. A demonstrated ability to learn MongoDB technologies is important to success in this role.
  • Understanding of database performance concepts. This includes query behavior, indexing, resource utilization and performance monitoring.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based database platforms such as MongoDB Atlas, Azure SQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Amazon Web Services database services or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and troubleshooting tools. Able to use metrics, logs and alerts to assist with technical investigations.
  • Basic understanding of cloud networking and application connectivity. Familiarity with authentication, access control and security concepts is also expected.
  • Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle. Familiarity with change management, incident management and Agile methodologies is beneficial.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to production incidents as needed.
  • Required to complete the MongoDB University MongoDB Atlas Administrator Path within the first three months of employment.
  • Required to successfully complete the MongoDB Atlas Administrator Exam and earn the MongoDB Associate Atlas Administrator certification within the first six months of employment.

Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, HSA and FSA, generous earned time off, 401K/student loan repayment, life insurance & AD&D insurance, employee assistance program, employee stock purchase program, tuition reimbursement, performance-based incentive pay, short- and long-term disability, and a robust wellness program. About Pantheon

Pantheon is the WebOps platform for websites that deliver extraordinary results. We believe in putting the magic of the internet in everyone's hands. That's why we're so passionate about helping developers, IT and marketing develop, test, and release website changes faster and more reliably so they can build and maintain websites that create value for their organizations. Our cloud native software makes it easy to securely manage a single website or thousands of websites across multiple teams in one platform.

Pantheon's core company values are Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First. At Pantheon, we work hard and play harder, valuing individuality, humor, and balance. We're enthusiastic participants in several open-source communities and have real relationships with many of our most active customers. If all of this sounds interesting to you, read on!

The Role

Pantheon is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Connectivity & API Transformation team. We're expanding an impressive and growing platform that powers hundreds of thousands of websites, millions of containerized resources, billions of monthly page views, and development tools that professional website developers use.

Our team owns the connective tissue of that platform: the federated GraphQL API that every Pantheon surface is built on, the network layer and discovery patterns that let our services find and reach each other, the orchestration layer that runs customer-facing automation, and the ongoing work of decomposing our legacy core into well-bounded modern services. It's a role with unusual leverage — the interfaces and pathways you design become the contract that every other engineering team at Pantheon builds against.

Pantheon's core company values are Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First. Additionally, the Pantheon engineering teams are built around a focus on collaboration, character, autonomy, and a no-blame culture. We're enthusiastic participants in several open-source communities and have real relationships with many of our most active customers.

If all of this sounds interesting to you, read on!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and evolving Pantheon's unified API — a federated GraphQL supergraph (Grafbase, Federation v2) and the Go subgraphs behind it that serve our Dashboard and public API
  • Shaping how Pantheon's services find and reach one another — VPC and network architecture, service discovery strategy, and the connectivity standards our internal traffic runs on
  • Decomposing a large legacy Python monolith into well-bounded services, and owning the Cassandra data layer behind it — replication, backup, and disaster recovery
  • Designing and operating workflow orchestration at platform scale: GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub-driven job execution, and Go services on Cloud Run that run customer-facing automation
  • Setting the GraphQL, gRPC, and REST standards other Pantheon teams build against, and acting as a technical resource for initiatives across the org
  • Owning your team's production systems — tracking health with SLOs, resolving production issues, and balancing delivery speed against reliability
  • Supporting Pantheon as a member of our on-call engineering rotation and your team's alert response rotation
  • Raising the level of engineers around you through code review, design feedback, and mentorship

What You Need to Succeed

  • Significant work experience building and operating production services in Go, and the adaptability to work in a polyglot codebase — our stack also includes Rust and Python
  • Experience designing APIs that other teams depend on, with real judgment about schema design, versioning, and backward compatibility. GraphQL, gRPC, or REST at scale all count
  • Work-related experience with large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems, and with designing scalable and robust services in the real world
  • Experience carving services out of a monolith, or otherwise evolving a legacy system incrementally while keeping it running
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking fundamentals — VPCs, DNS, load balancing, and service-to-service authentication — and the judgment to make network boundaries a deliberate design choice rather than an accident
  • Understanding and working knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and release engineering practices
  • Experience with a major cloud provider; GCP especially welcome
  • Experience leveraging observability tooling like Grafana Cloud, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to understand systems in production
  • Experience supporting live sites and participating in on-call
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to represent your contributions and ideas with clarity while remaining open and giving space to the contributions and ideas of others

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with GraphQL Federation, a federation gateway or router (Grafbase, Apollo, Hive), or a schema registry
  • Working knowledge of Rust
  • Experience with Cassandra, or with running a stateful datastore in production — backups, DR, multi-region replication
  • Experience migrating off end-of-life language runtimes (for example, Python 2)
  • Hands-on experience with private service networking or a service mesh — Shared VPC, VPC peering, Private Service Connect, internal DNS, Istio/Envoy
  • Working knowledge of GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Build
  • Working knowledge of AlloyDB, MySQL, Redis
  • Working knowledge of Docker, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Vault
  • Working knowledge of WordPress, Drupal

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave (PSL) and 11 Paid Company Holidays

About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. ISSA is looking for a Controller!

Please note: 100% Remote position (must reside in an ISSA-eligible state: (AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, NC, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI).

About ISSA: ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more! For over 35 years, ISSA has developed a personal fitness training program that combines gym experience with practical, applied science. With over 300 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries. We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!

We are adding a Controller to our team of relationship-builders, laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into everyday life!

So What's the Job?

  • As the Controller at ISSA, reporting to the CFO, you will be responsible for the oversight of all accounting and accounting operational activities. As a hands-on yet strategic leader, you will oversee the day-to-day accounting operations while developing processes and utilizing technology to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the accounting cycle. You will partner with organizational leaders to drive implementation of new projects and ensure financial compliance across the organization.

Build and Lead a World-Class Accounting Organization:

  • Develop team structure and roles required to support the accounting and accounting operations needs of the entire organization. Build Job Descriptions and related plans and work with Recruitment to fill open roles, as needed.
  • Champion a culture of innovation and creativity to automate and find efficiencies and scalability opportunities
  • Leadership and management of a high-performing team with focus on individual development, efficient prioritization, and delivery of high-quality output while meeting key deadlines

Accounting

  • Manage the accounting close processes and consolidations to meet internal and external deadlines
  • Prepare financials in both GAAP and Bookings basis for internal and external audiences, meeting internal and external deadlines
  • Oversee all accounts, ledgers, and reporting systems ensuring compliance with GAAP standards, regulatory requirements, and lender covenants
  • Coordinate and manage the annual audit and tax prep engagements and related required reporting
  • Ensure and document appropriate internal controls and separation of duties

Accounting Operations

  • Oversee cash management functions, treasury, and daily banking
  • Maintain annual and 13-Week Cash Forecast and provide insights into variances between actual and forecast
  • Oversee the Accounts Payable Function, including vendor management, 1099 reporting, accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, and employee expense reports
  • Oversee management of corporate credit card programs
  • Oversee Accounts Receivable function as related to non-standard contracts

Tax & Compliance

  • Manage sales tax automation software
  • Oversee Sales Tax Analysis and Assessment
  • Guide the implementation and setup of ongoing registrations for all required tax filings, including income and payroll
  • Design a process for continued monitoring and compliance with new tax and business registration requirements.
  • Coordinate and manage annual income tax engagement
  • Oversee accuracy and timeliness of all payroll-related filings, regulations, and compliance items

Strategic Improvements and Efficiencies

  • Partner with the Technology team to design new processes across the order-to-cash phase of accounting to align with new technology solutions, up to and including identification of a new ERP
  • Decrease days to close from 8 to 3
  • Utilize technology to automate reconciliations, entries, and reporting
  • Enhance efficiencies related to GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition methodology and processes
  • Provide strategic, implementation, and due diligence support related to M&A targets
  • Migrate ownership of payroll function from HR to Finance and oversee payroll administration function

What is ISSA looking for?

  • 10+ years of relevant, progressive experience required, with 2+ years of experience as a Controller
  • 3+ years of experience in public accounting with a “Big 8” firm, ideally in audit, preferred
  • Experience in an eCommerce business environment with a deep understanding of performance marketing preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance and CPA required, MBA a plus
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and IFRS
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage technology to improve processes
  • Experience managing financial systems selection and implementation/integration
  • Experience with Private Equity ownership and M&A Transactions preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, Jet Reports, and Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is a plus
  • Highest standards of accuracy and precision as well as excellent organizational skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to clearly communicate with different levels in the organization
  • Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to non-financial audiences
  • Strong work ethic and a high sense of urgency are required
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work independently
  • Self-starter who is intellectually curious and not afraid to seek out projects independently
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Passion for health, fitness, nutrition, or personal training is a definite plus!

WHO is ISSA looking for?

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA, we're looking for the same kind of person.

  • Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
  • Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
  • Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
  • Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.

We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.

We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks:

This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:

Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? After 90 days, employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!

Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.

Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members have 3 weeks of PTO each year...accrued on a bi-weekly basis! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday!

Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families. Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component of living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.

Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.

Growth Opportunities: When our people grow…we grow! We offer leadership training, coaching/mentoring opportunities, and cross-functional collaboration on special projects and initiatives. Constant growth and development are inherent in our culture.

Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

100% Remote Work: You can say goodbye to long commutes because all of our roles can be performed from the comfort of your own home. To connect and communicate more effectively, ISSA is a camera-friendly culture in which cameras are on for scheduled meetings. We have found that this bridges the gap that can exist since we are not working together in an office.

What Else? We have a 401(k) company match and 100% company-paid life/AD&D insurance/short-term disability. We also offer an employee assistance program to assist with work-life concerns (legal, financial, and mental health). Our ultimate goal is to support you and your overall wellness.

Transform your career at ISSA!

jobs.description:
The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

We have state-of-the-art facilities with imaging and diagnostics on-site in New York City, Palm Beach, and Los Angeles, with home services hubs in Miami, Greenwich/Westchester, and the Hamptons in summer. Additional locations are forthcoming in the Bay Area, Miami, and in downtown Manhattan. At each of our Institutes, we deliver personalized preventive medicine grounded in up-to-the-minute science — all in serene environments designed for trust and comfort.

Role Overview

As a Senior AI Scientist at Atria, you will own the development of the medical models at the heart of Atria's clinical AI agenda: domain-specific models for the clinical problems that matter most to our practice today, and foundation models for preventive medicine that learn the underlying patterns of how health evolves over years and decades, surfacing risk before symptoms appear and personalizing prevention to the individual rather than the population average. You'll work on a data estate that very few organizations in the world have access to: whole-genome sequencing, advanced imaging including whole-body MRI, comprehensive longitudinal labs, continuous wearable signals, and family-linked records spanning multiple generations. Your core job is to take the best of what the open-source ecosystem has to offer and turn it into models that materially outperform off-the-shelf options on Atria's problems. Where the problem demands it, you'll design fundamentally new architectures.

What you'll do

• Own the medical modeling roadmap at Atria: identify the model families and training approaches most likely to win on our problems, and build the models that prove it. The bar is "moves the clinical needle", not "places on a leaderboard".

• Survey the open-source landscape (general-purpose and clinical/biomedical foundation models, vision and

multimodal backbones, specialized medical models) and make defensible recommendations on what to fine-tune, distill, or build on.

• Design and validate novel architectures where existing approaches fall short, particularly for longitudinal multi-modal data and the foundation-model direction.

• Lead fine-tuning and post-training work: SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and other PEFT methods, DPO and related preference-tuning approaches, RLHF/RLAIF where appropriate, continued pre-training, and distillation.

• Curate high-quality training datasets from Atria's clinical data: sampling, labeling strategy, deduplication, contamination checks, train/test hygiene, and PHI-safe handling throughout.

• Design and run rigorous evaluation: held-out clinical benchmarks, comparison against frontier closed-source baselines, calibration analysis, subgroup performance, and the ablations that tell you which design choices actually earned their keep.

• Run training and evaluation on appropriate infrastructure (single-node and multi-GPU), with proper experiment tracking, reproducible configs, and the kind of logging that lets your future self understand what your past self did.

• Stay current with the literature: training methods, fine-tuning techniques, medical foundation models, multimodal architectures. Synthesize what's actually relevant for Atria rather than reporting every new arXiv preprint as a strategic threat.

• Collaborate with clinicians on what "good" looks like for each model, and with research partners on joint training and evaluation work.

Requirements

• A bias toward shipping models, not papers about models. You would rather have a working v1 in front of clinicians next month than a beautiful methodology that ships next year.

• A scrappy streak. You can pick up an unfamiliar fine-tuning technique, training framework, or clinical concept on a Wednesday and have a credible experiment running by Friday.

• A serious drive to keep getting better. You read other people's code, papers, training logs, and post-mortems. You treat being wrong as cheap information.

• Graduate degree (PhD preferred, Master's with strong research record) in computer science, machine learning, computational biology, biomedical informatics, or a closely related field — or a strong open-source track record in modern training and fine-tuning.

• Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning modern deep learning models, with a track record of shipped or published models you personally trained: 4+ years.

• Deep, current fluency with modern fine-tuning and post-training methods: SFT, PEFT (LoRA, QLoRA, adapters), preference tuning (DPO and successors), distillation, and continued pre-training.

• Strong working knowledge of the open-source model ecosystem: which models are state of the art, which are overrated, and what's worth fine-tuning for a given problem.

• Strong Python and PyTorch, with hands-on experience with the Hugging Face ecosystem (transformers, datasets, PEFT, TRL, accelerate) or equivalent training stacks.

• Practical experience with training infrastructure: distributed training, mixed precision, efficient data loading, experiment tracking (W, MLflow, or similar).

• Discipline around evaluation and ablation: you treat benchmarking, calibration, and "what would this have looked like without that change?" as part of the modeling work.

• Genuine interest in healthcare and the responsibility that comes with building models that affect patient care.

Nice to have

• Experience building multimodal medical models, combining clinical text with imaging (radiology, pathology, ophthalmology), structured labs, or physiological signals.

• Familiarity with clinical/biomedical foundation models (e.g., Med-PaLM, MedGemma, BioMedLM, BiomedCLIP, RadFM) and the medical model literature.

• Peer-reviewed publications in ML, NLP, computer vision, or clinical informatics venues. • Experience with reinforcement learning, reasoning model training, or other frontier post-training techniques. • Experience with model interpretability and uncertainty quantification for clinical settings. • Prior collaboration with clinicians on models that shipped.

Job Description

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Contracts & Pricing Strategy, Associate Director


What you will do


The Contracts & Pricing Strategy Associate Director leads integrated U.S. pricing and contracting economics for OaR across launch and lifecycle planning. Reporting to the Dir Contracts & Pricing Strategy, the role translates the overall Obesity and Related Conditions contracts, pricing and value strategy into payer and Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBM) recommendations, Gross to Net (GTN) and latest estimate discount rate (LEDR) process, and coordinated channel economics. The role partners with the Consumer Director and Employer Lead Director to incorporate approved assumptions while they retain channel strategy and relationships. Prior-authorization and utilization-management analysis remain with the Coverage Lead.


Core responsibilities:


Pricing and contracting strategy:


  • Lead development of U.S. pricing and contracting recommendations for MariTide across commercial, Medicare and Medicaid channels across all payers and pharmacy benefit managers (PBM)
  • Build account and portfolio economics, bid and negotiation scenarios, access-price trade-offs and guardrails.
  • Partner with Coverage, Market Access, Contract Development and Contracting and Pricing Execution to translate approved strategy into executable contract terms.

Integrated GTN and business planning:


  • Lead the Obesity latest estimate discount rate (LEDR) process and maintain the integrated gross to net (GTN) and net-sales view used in launch planning, quarterly business reviews and long-range planning.
  • Reconcile rebates, fees, affordability, trade, government and channel-mix assumptions; run base, upside and downside scenarios; document key dependencies; and explain actual-to-plan variances and changes in forward assumptions.

Consumer and employer economics:


  • Partner with the Consumer Director and Employer Lead Director to incorporate approved retail-pharmacy, cash-reimbursement and Direct to Employer (DTE) assumptions into gross to net (GTN).
  • Model patient contribution, pharmacy and fulfillment fees, employer and member contributions, program fees, eligible lives, sites, enrollment, activation, utilization, persistence and ramp.
  • Govern membership inputs and reconcile patient migration and population overlap across channels.

Launch and lifecycle pricing:


  • Translate Global value and pricing considerations into U.S. launch scenarios and communicate U.S. channel implications to Global partners.
  • Develop assumptions, analogs, sensitivity ranges and decision triggers where actuals do not exist.
  • Extend the pricing and gross to net (GTN) architecture to future indications and sequencing decisions as populations, evidence, benefit management, utilization and channel mix evolve.

Governance and cross-functional leadership:


  • Lead cross-functional pricing workstreams with Finance, Forecasting, Accounting, Government Pricing, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Trade, Brand and Market Access.
  • Establish common model definitions, documentation and review cadence; identify duplicate-discount, classification, reporting, privacy and channel-conflict risks; and present clear recommendations, alternatives and unresolved issues to the Director and senior governance.

What we expect of you


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is someone with these qualifications.

Basic qualifications:


  • Doctorate degree and 3 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • Master’s degree and 5 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • Associate’s degree and 12 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience; OR
  • High school diploma or GED and 14 years of pricing, contracting, market access, finance, accounting, analytics or sales and marketing operations experience.

Preferred qualifications:


  • Substantial U.S. pharmaceutical pricing, payer or PBM contracting, GTN forecasting or launch financial-planning experience, ideally in a high-volume chronic or cardiometabolic market.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise forecast or economic model that integrates assumptions from multiple business owners and supports senior decisions.
  • Experience with reimbursed, cash, employer, affordability, trade and government flows and their implications for GTN and price reporting.
  • Ability to govern eligible-life and membership cohorts, channel migration, transaction economics, data lineage and model controls.
  • Strong executive communication and influence without direct authority; advanced Excel and enterprise planning or deal-modeling experience preferred.

What you can expect of us


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

As an Associate Project Manager specializing in data centers, you will support the delivery of mission-critical infrastructure projects while developing your expertise in this highly technical and fast-paced sector. Working under the guidance of senior project managers and program leaders, you will assist with day-to-day project coordination, documentation, and client communication for data center construction and fit-out projects. Project Coordination & Administration

jobs.description:
Senior Director, AP Assessment Design and Insights

College Board – AP&I

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

The College Board’s Advanced Placement and Instruction division (300+ staff) develops and administers coursework taken by more than 3 million students worldwide each school year, and the related subject-matter exams utilized by more than 4,000 colleges and universities for course placement and awarding of college credit. These include credit and placement examination programs like CLEP and ACCUplacer; Advanced Placement (AP) and Pre-AP courses in 40+ disciplines; and associated teacher professional learning programs.

To support the continued growth and evolution of the program, the AP Program Enablement team is designed to oversee the end-to-end management of the AP Course Roadmap, as well as the assessment design and systems requirements, processes and production functions that underpin all new and existing AP courses and exams. This team plays a central role in ensuring alignment, quality, and efficiency across the full lifecycle of course and assessment production.

Within AP Program Enablement, the AP Assessment Design & Systems team functions as the cross-cutting backbone accountable for the assessment design, systems, and requirements making “build to score and report” possible across all AP courses and exams. Assessment Design & Systems governs the end-to-end integration across the full platform ecosystem, assessment design and requirements, the integrity and certification layer, and the knowledge and data governance, serving as the connective tissue other Program Enablement functions rely on to operate as one coherent system. This scope spans all 40+ existing AP courses and new courses in active development and underpins the program’s digital transformation and strategic priorities.


About the Opportunity

As Senior Director, AP Assessment Design and Insights, you will serve as a senior strategic leader and analytical engine within the AP Assessment Design & Systems team within AP Program Enablement, driving the assessment design infrastructure, systems strategy, and knowledge architecture that underpin AP’s assessment work across existing courses and a growing portfolio of new course development. This role sits at the intersection of assessment design, data-informed strategy, and cross-functional leadership, and is essential to ensuring that AP’s assessment design, systems, and resources are coherent, current, and positioned for the program’s long-term evolution.

You will lead and advance AP's assessment design infrastructure, from intake frameworks for new and revised courses to the team's assessment resources, knowledge base, and systems roadmap, working in close partnership with the Executive Director, who sets the strategic direction for the team. You will serve as an authoritative voice on assessment design standards and requirements across the AP ecosystem, a trusted partner to technology and product teams, and the primary driver of the divisional AP Assessment Community of Practice. This is an ideal role for a senior assessment leader who combines deep expertise in educational assessment with the strategic and analytical capabilities to advance a complex, high-stakes program at scale.


In this Role, You Will:

Lead Assessment Systems Strategy and Resources (40%)

  • Lead execution of AP's assessment systems roadmap strategy in close partnership with the Executive Director, ensuring it accurately reflects assessment requirements and priorities across current and new course portfolios and advances AP's broader digital transformation goals.
  • Drive annual execution and maintenance of the AP digital assessment inventory, scoping exam requirements across systems for upcoming administration years and ensuring alignment with the AP digital assessment roadmap and College Board strategic priorities.
  • Lead the design and architecture of the AP Assessment Design & Systems SharePoint environment, ensuring assessment resources, tools, and documentation are organized in a manner that is intuitive, navigable, and current.
  • Serve as a primary voice in systems and digital roadmap discussions with AP product and technology teams, ensuring assessment strategic priorities, requirements and dependencies are accurately represented and tracked across the ecosystem.
  • Translate complex assessment systems data into clear, actionable insights for the Executive Director and senior leadership through data visualizations, executive reporting, and strategic presentation materials.
  • Apply knowledge of assessment industry standards, interoperability protocols, accessibility requirements, and generative AI tools to strengthen AP assessment systems requirements and position the program for continued digital evolution.

Lead Assessment Design Strategy and Resources (40%)

  • Develop and own the assessment design intake framework for new and revised AP courses, establishing a structured process and assets that guide course teams through the full arc of assessment development from inception through exam production.
  • Own the development and stewardship of AP’s assessment design knowledge base, including assessment principles and best practices, item design guidance, item and form development, form assembly standards, psychometric and validity standards, fairness frameworks, and resources that support both current and new course teams and that apply throughout the item and form development lifecycle.
  • Partner with the Executive Director and Psychometrics to guide and implement multi-year test form planning, ensuring AP’s form strategy supports validity, equity, and psychometric soundness across all subjects.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Executive Director on assessment design priorities, flagging risks and dependencies across new and existing course pipelines and recommending solutions.
  • Support the integration of innovative item design elements and emerging assessment practices into AP’s assessment resource infrastructure, ensuring the program remains at the leading edge of educational assessment design and digital assessment.

Lead the Divisional AP Assessment Community of Practice (20%)

  • Lead the AP Assessment community of practice at a divisional level, setting the strategic agenda for sessions and ensuring the community functions as a high-value, cross-collaborative professional learning forum.
  • Own speaker outreach and engagement, identifying, cultivating, and coordinating internal and external subject matter experts whose expertise aligns with strategic priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Executive Director to ensure Community of Practice sessions address timely, relevant, and high-impact assessment topics, including psychometrics, fairness, digital assessment, innovative design, assessment systems, and generative AI.
  • Serve as the primary logistics and execution partner for the AP Assessment Community of Practice, including end-to-end event logistics, session asset quality, and an ongoing archive of sessions and resources to support the community’s growth as a division-wide, cross-collaborative forum.

About You

  • 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in assessment design, test development, or assessment systems.
  • Deep expertise in educational assessment design, including how assessments are built, validated, and delivered at scale, and fluency in the psychometric, fairness, and design principles that underpin high-quality, large-scale exams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead strategic initiatives across assessment design, systems, and knowledge management, and to translate complex assessment and technical requirements into clear, actionable direction for diverse partners.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders, including product, technology, psychometrics, and curriculum and assessment teams, with the intelligence, nuance, and persuasion to move complex, multi-party work forward without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with experience synthesizing complex data and assessment information into executive-level insights, visualizations, and presentations.
  • Fluency in industry-standard assessment design conventions and data structures, including blueprints, test and form constraints, item pools, and scoring specifications, with the ability to engage substantively in requirements discussions with technology and product partners.
  • Knowledge of assessment content standards and interoperability protocols, such as QTI, APIP, HTML, WCAG, and metadata schemas, sufficient to inform AP assessment systems requirements and evaluate technical options; familiarity with item data protocols including JSON, programming languages such as Python or SAS, and accessibility frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in SharePoint, Smartsheet, and PowerPoint, with demonstrated experience building data visualizations and executive-level reporting artifacts.
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft 365 suite and familiarity with collaboration and work management platforms such as Productboard, Jira, and Confluence.

All Roles at College Board Require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal.
  • A learner’s mindset and commitment to growth through feedback and collaboration.
  • A drive for impact and excellence through data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck, we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $104,000–$155,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Visit our careers page for more.

Position Title:

This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.

This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.

At Mastercard technology, we work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible.
