  • Helping agents win deals through strategic content, not viral gimmicks

We believe in extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and beyond excellence. If that resonates, you'll thrive here.

We're hiring a Lead Editor to deliver high-quality edits consistently and help us maintain our quality standards across the team as we scale.

To Apply Now:

The Role

As a Lead Editor at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of video editors who transform raw real estate content into high-impact YouTube videos that help agents dominate their local markets. This is a player-coach leadership role where you'll spend 70-90% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 10-30% hands-on editing complex projects.

You'll own editing quality standards, team development, and operational excellence within your pod, partnering closely with Pod Managers, YouTube Managers, and Strategists to deliver retention-driven content at scale. Your success is measured not by how many videos you edit, but by how well your team performs, grows, and retains talent.

This role is perfect for someone who loves developing editors as much as editing itselfsomeone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying their impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, or purely hands-off without getting in the weeds of editing, this isn't the right fit.

To Apply Now:

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & Development (50% of role)

  • Manage and develop 25-50 video editors, conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill progression and performance (with the support of multiple Senior Editors & YouTube Managers)
  • Lead weekly team edit reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Lead monthly team trainings for the editing team culture & growth
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new editor hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for your team
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Participate in hiring (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring recommendations)
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with editors through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Implement skip-level check-ins to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Quality Standards & Systems (20-30% of role)

  • Establish QA processes that maintain >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors
  • Serve as final quality review and approval for complex or high-stakes edits before client delivery
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and retention analysis, translating data into actionable editing improvements
  • Create efficiency systems (templates, motion graphics libraries, workflow optimizations)
  • Build performance dashboards tracking team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention performance)
  • Drive continuous improvement through weekly "edit of the week" reviews and retrospectives

Strategic Collaboration (10-15% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Manager and YouTube Managers on content strategy and creative direction
  • Participate in Monthly Client Strategy Calls to present editing approach and performance insights
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with scriptwriters and designers to align on creative vision
  • Communicate proactively with leadership on team capacity, blockers, and resource needs
  • Contribute to quarterly planning and annual strategy with editing function perspective
  • Handle client escalations and quality issues with transparency and solutions-focused approach

Player-Coach Editing (10-20% of role)

  • Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per month for VIP clients or training demonstrations
  • Model excellence by staying hands-on with the craft and maintaining YouTube editing fluency
  • Stay current on YouTube editing trends, competitor content, and platform algorithm changes
  • Experiment with new techniques and tools, sharing learnings and innovations with the team
  • Maintain organized project files and asset management as an example for the team

Requirements

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional editing craft with proven leadership ability. You should be passionate about developing talent and building systems that multiply impact across a team, not just delivering great edits yourself.

Leadership & Management Experience

  • 5-7+ years of professional video editing experience with 2+ years managing or leading editors
  • Proven track record developing and scaling editing teams of 4+ people
  • Experience hiring editors (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring decisions)
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • History of conducting performance reviews and managing accountability (including difficult conversations)
  • Experience building onboarding programs, training materials, and documented workflows
  • Comfortable with the full people management cycle: hiring, coaching, performance management, and when necessary, firing

Technical Mastery (You Can Teach Others)

  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro - you can troubleshoot complex technical issues and teach advanced techniques
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve, Blender, or other tools (or quick learner)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, storytelling, and algorithm optimization
  • Ability to QA others' work and identify issues across editing style, technical execution, and brand consistency
  • Portfolio showcasing both your own work AND examples of team development (before/after of editors you've coached)

Systems & Process Thinking

  • Experience building scalable editing workflows, style guides, and template systems
  • Understanding of capacity planning and resource allocation for editing teams
  • Ability to create performance dashboards and track team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention)
  • Skilled at documentation - SOPs, training materials, and knowledge management
  • Process optimization mindset - constantly looking for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality
  • Experience with project management tools (Asana, Notion, Frame.io) and team collaboration systems

Strategic & Business Acumen

  • Ability to translate business objectives into editing strategy and creative direction
  • Comfortable presenting to clients and defending creative decisions with data and performance insights
  • Understanding of editing team economics (capacity planning, turnaround times, quality vs. speed tradeoffs)
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with strategists, writers, designers, and YouTube managers
  • Can navigate ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information
  • Thinks beyond individual edits to how editing impacts channel growth and client business results

Communication & Influence

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and team documentation
  • Ability to give direct, constructive feedback that motivates rather than demoralizes
  • Skilled at managing up (keeping leadership informed), across (collaborating with peers), and down (developing direct reports)
  • Proactive communication style - you flag capacity issues, quality concerns, and team challenges before they become crises
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, client escalations, conflict resolution)
  • Can translate technical editing concepts into language that non-editors understand

Work Style & Mindset

  • Player-coach mentality - willing to stay hands-on with editing (10-20% of time) while primarily focusing on team leadership
  • Excellent organizational skills managing both your own work and your team's project pipeline
  • Ability to balance competing priorities: team development, quality standards, client deadlines, and strategic initiatives
  • Comfortable context-switching between hands-on editing, team coaching, client calls, and strategic planning
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are constantly evolving
  • Gets energized by developing talent and seeing team members succeed

Cultural Leadership

  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; models this for direct reports
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to consistently exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of issues
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development, not personal recognition

Results You'll Drive

Team Performance

  • Your editing team consistently maintains >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors
  • Editor retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New editors productive at 80% capacity within 60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Systems

  • Zero client escalations due to editing quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Editing workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Average video retention improves 5-10% year-over-year through data-driven editing strategies

Strategic Impact

  • Editing function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with editing insights that drive performance
  • Your team supports clients publishing 4+ videos per month consistently
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for editing quality and communication
  • At least 1-2 editors promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship

Player-Coach Excellence

  • Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per week as benchmarks and training examples
  • Your edits consistently achieve 8-10% average retention (above platform benchmarks)
  • Model extreme ownership, excellence, and proactive curiosity through your work

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

What We Offer:

  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Time Off policy (we trust you to manage your time and energy)

  • Opportunities to earn Monthly wellness allowance, Home office stipend, Professional development budget &/or Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period)

REAL TALK:

This is an early-stage startup scaling rapidly. You'll face challenges - processes break, priorities shift, and things get messy. We need people who are resilient, resourceful, and committed long-term.

But if you want to:

  • Help America's top real estate leaders dominate their local markets

This is the place.

Remote-first,

Our client is a historic landmark hotel in the heart of Mildura's shopping and dining precinct, a short stroll from the Murray River, and has overlooked the city since 1889.

On site are The Spanish Grill, an award-winning charcoal-fired steakhouse with over 23 years of history, and the Coffee Palace cafe.

The Role

The hotel is looking for a Marketing Specialist to look after the hotel's website, run its social media, and drive new bookings and customers through paid ads. The role also covers social media for the hotel's two on-site venues, The Spanish Grill and the Coffee Palace, so the specialist needs to be comfortable running three distinct brands under one roof.

Experience in the hotel or hospitality industry is ideal, along with an open mind for new ideas that help the business grow and strengthen its brand.

Website Maintenance & Updates

Hotel Social Media

Own the hotel's social presence and build a consistent, recognisable brand.

  • Plan and post consistent content across the hotel's social channels

Restaurant & Cafe Social Media

  • Manage social media for The Spanish Grill, promoting its charcoal-grill dining and private dining

  • Keep each venue distinct while staying consistent with the wider brand

Paid Advertising

Use paid ads to gain traction and bring in new customers across the hotel and its venues.

  • Plan, run, and optimise Meta Ads campaigns to drive direct bookings, function and wedding enquiries, and restaurant and cafe visits

Growth & Brand Ideas

  • 5+ years of hands-on marketing experience, ideally within the hotel or hospitality industry

Share examples of social media and paid ads work you have done for a hotel, restaurant, cafe, or similar hospitality business, along with any results you can point to.

Intelligence Gathering

  • Deploys Global Site and Study Operations (GSSO) site strategies by qualifying and activating assigned sites

  • Supports processes to optimize country and site selection activities including review and assessment of the draft potential site list and provide Pre-Trial Assessment (PTA) output for site selection

  • Maintains a thorough knowledge of assigned protocols

  • Conducts study start up activities at the site level including but not limited to PTA, coordination of site activation checklist items, Informed Consent Document (ICD) finalization, Site Initiation Visit (SIV), as applicable, including management of issues that may compromise time to site activation

  • Ensures all the site initiation activities completed including training per site activation checklist, collect and complete necessary documentation and systems needed

  • Supports country specific ICD review and deployment when applicable

  • Ensures follow up activities are completed post PTA and SIV to ensure site readiness for First Subject First Visit (FSFV)

  • Provides support for escalated site issues related to study delivery by coordinating communications and resolution efforts (e.g., vendor, site contracts and payment issues etc.)

  • Accountable for effective site recruitment planning and delivery, consistent with global and/or country plan and local targets

  • Maintains regular communications with investigator sites to gather status updates and drive delivery to study goals (e.g. recruitment, data entry timelines etc.)

  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role


Devoted Health is redefining healthcare. We are seeking a physician leader to help build our national Musculoskeletal (MSK) practice — a new clinical program built on the backbone of Devoted Medical's AI platform and delivered to a member population that is already deeply engaged with us.


MSK is one of the largest sources of pain, disability, and avoidable spend for the seniors we serve, and it is poorly served on both ends of the market. The traditional system routes back pain and knee osteoarthritis toward imaging, injections, and surgery that many members never needed. Existing virtual MSK solutions mostly sell exercise videos to healthy commercial populations and quietly fail the frail, the multimorbid, and the post-operative.


We think there is a better model, and we are looking for the physician to build it by example. You will help to define the care model, translate best-in-class care patterns into an agentic system that scales, and build the team that puts a high-trust, high-empathy human overlay on top of it. This is a player-coach role with a real panel of patients attached — you will practice the medicine you are designing, and the model you write will become how tens of thousands of members experience MSK care.


You will not start from zero. Devoted Medical already operates a suite of virtual and in-home clinical programs, an AI platform embedded across our clinical workflows, and an engaged member base that answers the phone when we call. Your work is to recombine what already works with the new elements MSK demands.


Responsibilities and impact will include


Design the care model. Own the clinical architecture of the MSK program end to end: which conditions we take on and in what order, how members enter and are triaged, what a first visit looks like, how we escalate to imaging or surgical consultation and when we hold, how we manage pain without defaulting to opioids, and how we handle peri-operative optimization and post-operative recovery. You will define the pathways for the conditions that carry the most burden — low back and neck pain, hip and knee osteoarthritis, shoulder pain, fragility fracture and osteoporosis, falls and deconditioning — with enough precision that the model performs the same way in Ohio as it does in Texas.


Build the AI system. Work shoulder to shoulder with our product and engineering teams to build the agentic interface that delivers this care. You will encode clinical reasoning into the system, specify what it should ask, notice, escalate, and never do, and then supervise it the way you would supervise a fellow. You will also shape how members experience it: how we engage people between visits, sustain adherence to a home program, and detect the member who is quietly getting worse. Expect to write prompts, review transcripts, argue about edge cases, and ship.


Deliver care. Carry a shared panel and practice within the model you are building. You will be the clinical backstop for diagnostic ambiguity, red flags, complex multimorbid presentations, and the cases where the right answer is not in the pathway.


Build the team. Hire, train, and lead the clinicians who deliver this care — Advanced Practice Providers, physical therapists, and care team members. You will set the standard for what a Devoted MSK encounter feels like, hold collaborative practice agreements across multiple states, run case review and interdisciplinary rounds, and grow a team that scales nationally without losing the trust and empathy that make the model work.


Measure and improve. Our objective is to deliver the highest-quality MSK care in the nation, and we intend to prove it. You will build the quality measures, the balanced scorecard, and the feedback loops for the program — function and pain outcomes, appropriate imaging and surgical referral, opioid stewardship, member experience — and use them to iterate the model and the AI system on a fast cycle.


Attributes to success

  • Builder's instinct. You are energized by an unfinished thing. You would rather write version one, watch it meet reality, and rewrite it than wait for a fully specified plan.
  • Clinical excellence. Deep command of MSK medicine and a strong point of view on what good looks like — including a healthy skepticism toward low-value MSK care.
  • Fluency across clinical and technical work. You can hold a serious conversation with an engineer about system behavior and with a member about their knee, in the same hour.
  • Servant leadership. Everyone's success is your success. You enable your team to do their best work and they trust your guidance.
  • Adaptability and agility. Wired for learning and change, comfortable in a fast-paced, high-energy environment where the answer is often unknown at the start of the week.
  • Passion for improvement. Committed to building the MSK care you would want for your own family members.

Required skills and experience

  • Board-certified physician in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, Sports Medicine, Rheumatology, Orthopedic Surgery, or Internal Medicine / Family Medicine with substantial MSK practice
  • Significant clinical experience managing common MSK conditions in adults, including older adults with multimorbidity
  • Demonstrated experience building or substantially redesigning a clinical program, pathway, or service line — not only running one
  • A deep belief in measuring and improving quality across a population, and comfort being held to outcomes
  • Experience serving diverse patient populations, with care that aligns with our mission to treat every member like family

Desired skills and Experience

  • 5+ year of experience delivering MSK care in a sports medicine, PM&R, or orthopedics practice
  • Experience supervising Advanced Practice Providers, physical therapists, or other clinicians
  • Direct experience working with product and engineering teams to build clinical software or AI-enabled workflows
  • Experience with virtual or hybrid care delivery
  • Familiarity with Medicare Advantage populations and value-based care economics
  • Experience with peri-operative optimization, post-acute recovery, or falls and fracture prevention programs

Salary range: $280,000 - $305,000 per year, a annual performance bonus, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package


The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

  3. Demonstrated experience reviewing Gerber data and utilizing PCB CAM software for manufacturability and quality assurance.

Role Title: Robotics Expert

You'll review footage of robotic arms performing tasks and tag what happens in each session, using your robotics knowledge to judge whether the robot did the job correctly. No prior AI experience is required — your technical background is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Watch video recordings of robotic arms performing tasks and annotate them following a detailed set of guidelines.
  2. Tag actions, events, and errors in each video session, marking where each action starts and ends.

  4. Apply the labeling rules the same way across every session so the data stays consistent.
  5. Flag unclear or borderline cases to project managers instead of guessing, and help resolve them.
  6. Use your knowledge of robot motion, perception, sensors, and integration to explain what went wrong when a robot fails.
  7. Suggest improvements to the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or repeated confusion.
  8. Complete assigned annotation volume on time and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Background in robotics, mechanical engineering, electronics engineering, or a related technical field.

About Pandektes

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

We have raised more than €4M, including a €2.9M seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and a strong bench of angels. We already serve 450+ customers across Europe and we’re just getting started.

About the role

As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets.

You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. A big part of the role will be helping the team move further upmarket and win larger, more complex customers. You’ll stay close to the team and the deals, coaching regularly, joining important customer conversations and helping your AEs progress and close opportunities.

We’re still building, so there’s plenty of opportunity to shape how we sell. You’ll help us improve the way we work, build a more predictable pipeline and develop a sales team that can grow with the business.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our DACH Account Executive team

  • Coach the team through regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal reviews

  • Own team targets, pipeline and forecasting across the DACH market

  • Help the team win larger and more complex customers as we continue to move upmarket

  • Get involved in key deals and support the team with customer meetings, objections, negotiations and closing

  • Help Account Executives improve their discovery, pitching and ability to work with multiple stakeholders

  • Make sure we have a healthy pipeline and a clear view of where revenue is coming from

  • Look at where deals are progressing, where they are getting stuck and what we can do differently

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and the wider commercial team to improve how we find and win customers across our global target market

  • Improve our sales processes and playbooks as the team grows

  • Hire and onboard new Account Executives as we continue to build the DACH team

The experience you bring

  • Experience leading a B2B SaaS sales team, ideally with Account Executives selling into the DACH market

  • A strong sales background and a track record of delivering against team revenue targets

  • Experience working across different deal sizes, including larger opportunities with longer sales cycles and multiple decision makers

  • Experience helping a team move upmarket and win larger customers

  • You enjoy coaching and know how to help salespeople improve rather than simply telling them what to do

  • You’re comfortable getting involved in deals and working alongside your team when needed

  • You understand what good pipeline management and forecasting looks like

  • You’re confident using CRM data to understand performance and where the team needs support

  • You’re comfortable joining a growing company where processes are still being built and improved

  • You’re able to balance hitting the number today with building a stronger sales team for the future

  • Professional fluency in German and English

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

What we offer

You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, pension and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We have offices in Copenhagen, London and Hamburg. This role will be based in Germany with some travels to our offices to meet the team.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work - you can expect social events, opportunity to travel to our different locations to visit the teams, and offsites - our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chipewyan-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Chipewyan Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Chipewyan Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chipewyanand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inChipewyanand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

jobs.excerpt: Most AI teams talk about evaluation.  At Synera, you will own it: end-to-end, in production, for multiple real agentic products used by companies like BMW, Airbus, and NASA.
jobs.description:
Most AI teams talk about evaluation. At Synera, you will own it: end-to-end, in production, for multiple real agentic products used by companies like BMW, Airbus, and NASA.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

You’ll join the Agentic Ants team as their second native AI engineer. You’ll build and extend agentic systems alongside the rest of the team, including new tools, sub-agents and prompt iterations. But most importantly, you will contribute to an evaluation framework that gates every change: Golden datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, regression suites, production-trace mining. Your job is to prove that the agents the team is shipping can be trusted.

You’ll not only improve our existing software but also shape the next AI-native generation of Synera. Partnering with Danny and the wider R&D department, you’ll help the teams go deeper on customer insights data and come up with new ways to automate engineering work.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: Join our company-wide all-hands meeting to stay in the loop, then review Langfuse traces from the weekend and flag any new failure modes worth triaging.

  • Tuesday: Work on the golden dataset for the supervisor routing surface, curating examples, versioning the set, and writing evaluators with Ahmed.

  • Wednesday: Join a cross-team sync with QA and product to align on new eval coverage for an upcoming agent feature, then push a CI integration so eval regressions block the next PR.

  • Thursday: Show off your latest work to other departments in the sprint review, use your lunch break to go for a quick run, then kick off sprint planning with the Agentic Ants.

  • Friday: Pair with the AI and software engineers on extending our agentic system, then write the eval that gates the change before it ships.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • The evaluation framework is live and in use across multiple agent, CI gates are blocking on regressions, and the team can actually trust the results.

  • You’ve shipped multiple meaningful changes to the agent graphs (new tools, sub-agents, or routing improvements) that are measurably better in production.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • The agents improve themselves: Production traces feed continuously back into datasets, and the improvement loop is running without manual intervention.

  • You co-own at least one agent surface with the team and have become the go-to person for evaluation methodology at Synera. The combination has measurably improved product quality.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 77,000 - 97,000 EUR annually

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You’ve designed and shipped agent graphs in production with LangGraph or equivalent, including supervisor / sub-agent patterns, tool design, prompt iteration.

  • You’ve built or meaningfully contributed to an LLM evaluation pipeline: LLM-as-judge design, calibration against human labels, dataset versioning, and the statistical reasoning behind it (CIs, sample sizes, false positives).

  • You write production-grade Python (using FastAPI and PostgreSQL).

  • You’ve worked with at least two of the following AI platforms: Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure Froundry, Bedrock, or Vertex AI.

  • You’re familiar with Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar tracing tools.

  • You handle reliability when it shows up in your work, implementing retries, error handling, or graceful degradation.

  • You communicate clearly and push back when you disagree.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Agentic Ants team.

The Global Controller will lead the accounting team in producing accurate and timely financial statements, managing internal controls, overseeing audits, ensuring tax compliance and driving process improvements across all accounting operations. The Global Controller will also collaborate closely with senior leadership to align finance function goals and outcomes with strategic business objectives. While PharmaLogic is a private equity-backed company that is not subject to public company requirements, experience with public company reporting, disclosure, internal control and legal requirements is highly valued as the company continues to scale.

We operate with a flat structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter.   • Product Building: Code production-ready prototypes, modular front-end components, and core user-facing features.

  • Proactive Polish: Spot opportunities to redesign or refine key features and flows, aggressively hunting down visual "paper cuts" and UX friction.

  • Collaborative Scoping: Participate in project kickoffs to understand the product and audience, actively proposing visual direction rather than waiting for a rigid specification sheet.

  • Setting Standards: Champion application performance, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), and codebase maintainability as first-class architectural concerns.

  • Future-Proof Mindset: You write clean, maintainable code that doesn't constrain future product ambition.

  • Pragmatic Tooling: You use LLMs as a tool, not a crutch: you independently audit their output, question their assumptions, and override them whenever a more elegant, human-engineered solution is required.

  • Proven Product Taste: You possess a strong portfolio of shipped interfaces where you handled both the design and the front-end build, and can clearly explain your decisions and trade-offs.

  • Workflow Empathy: You have a deep understanding of design workflows and the technical or hardware constraints that surround them.

  • Obsession with Detail: You sweat the small stuff: animation, loading states, typography rhythm, accessibility, responsiveness, and runtime performance.

  • Principled Courage: You have the confidence to ask hard questions, experiment wildly, and advocate for what you feel is right for the user.

  • Relentless Curiosity: You treat every engineering bottleneck as a chance to dig deeper, constantly expanding your technical toolkit because you genuinely love figuring out how things work.

  • Ambiguity Tolerance: You thrive when things are moving fast. Mission-critical work in defense isn't always tidy, and priorities shift. You stay calm, adjust, and iterate.

  • Team-First Alignment: You make the team better. On a team of three, every hire shapes how we work. You bring your own strengths but check your ego at the door, taking your teammates' wins as your own.

  • Clear Communication: You can explain a technical decision, a design rationale, or a complex trade-off in a clear way that lands perfectly with any audience.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship: Must be a U.S. citizen.

  • Security Clearance: Must be able to obtain or currently hold a Secret or Top Secret U.S. security clearance.

Additional Benefit Opportunities When You Choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

JustPlay is looking for a (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a (Senior) Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will directly report to the Associate Director of Finance and you'll be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers and help build a controlling function that scales with the company. This is a growth role: you'll start by mentoring our FP&A team member, and in the mid-term take over leadership of the controlling function.

Job responsibilities

  • Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures.

  • Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions.

  • Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus.

  • Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX).

  • Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews.

  • Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons.

  • Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs).

  • Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV.

  • Team: Mentor and review the work of our junior FP&A team member, and grow into the leadership of the controlling function in the mid-term.

Job requirements

  • 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline.

  • End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models.

  • Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

  • Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures.

  • Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities.

Nice-to-have

  • Understanding of Ad monetisation and User Acquisition economics: network revenue and payout terms, eCPM, ROAS/LTV, and marketing spend cycles.

  • Experience with an Asian corporate parent or group reporting calendar

  • Hands-on experience with DATEV, Moss or Embat

  • Experience building a controlling function or KPI governance from scratch

  • Familiarity with multi-currency (USD/EUR) payment flows and FX effects

  • First experience mentoring or leading finance team members

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc.

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, freeWellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining model.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.excerpt: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Check out this Loom video for more details: We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond.

We're growing quickly and continuing to build our Sales organization. While we may not have an immediate Account Executive opening that aligns with your background, we're always interested in connecting with strong sales talent who may be a fit for future opportunities.

By joining our Account Executive Talent Pipeline, you'll be considered for upcoming roles as our team grows.

We're particularly interested in full-cycle Account Executives who know how to create their own opportunities, run strong sales processes, and close.

You might be a great fit for a future opportunity with Alternative Payments if you're energized by:

  • Owning your pipeline end to end, including outbound prospecting, account research, referrals, partnerships, and other creative approaches to generating pipeline.

  • Running the full sales cycle, from first touch through discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.

  • Managing a fast-moving pipeline while maintaining strong CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

  • Building strategic account plans, mapping buying committees, and navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes.

  • Selling through business value and ROI, particularly to finance, operations, and executive stakeholders.

  • Consistently hitting or exceeding quota in a high-accountability sales environment.

What We're Typically Looking For

Future Account Executive opportunities may vary in level and scope, but strong candidates will typically bring:

  • Several years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with demonstrated success generating and closing their own pipeline.

  • A history of carrying and achieving or exceeding quota.

  • Strong outbound and prospecting capabilities across email, phone, social, events, referrals, and other channels.

  • Experience selling B2B SaaS, FinTech, payments, or another technical solution.

  • Confidence leading value-based conversations with senior business stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach — you're comfortable operating independently and moving opportunities forward without waiting for direction.

  • Experience working with a modern sales tech stack such as Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools.

Bonus Points

We're especially interested in meeting people who have:

  • Experience in FinTech, payments, B2B SaaS, or startup/scale-up environments.

  • Sold to SMBs, MSPs, or service-based businesses.

  • Familiarity with accounts receivable, accounts payable, or financial operations workflows.

  • Helped build outbound playbooks or establish repeatable sales processes.

Location

Compensation

Compensation will depend on the specific opportunity, level, experience, and scope of the role. Our sales compensation packages typically include a base salary, performance-based variable compensation, and equity.

Specific compensation details will be shared when you're being considered for an active opening.

Why Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own your impact: Take meaningful ownership of deals and initiatives shaping the future of FinTech.

  • Build: Help define how we sell, operate, and scale — not simply inherit an established playbook.

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully so everyone understands where we stand and where we're headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and use the tools available to move quickly and intelligently.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together and collaborate across teams to solve difficult problems.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and look for better ways to operate.

  • Accountability: We own our decisions, commitments, and results.

Join Our Talent Pipeline

If Alternative Payments sounds like the kind of company where you'd like to build your next chapter, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note: This posting is for our Account Executive Talent Pipeline and does not represent a specific current vacancy. Joining the pipeline means our Talent team may reach out when an opportunity becomes available that aligns with your experience, interests, and location.

All resumes are reviewed by our Talent team. We may use AI-enabled tools to help us organize and prioritize applications, but real people are behind our hiring decisions.

jobs.excerpt: We are hiring a VC Analyst Intern to research the market and write what we find.
jobs.description:
We are hiring a VC Analyst Intern to research the market and write what we find.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the ones that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

The role

Why is this company worth a look, and why now? Is this sector heating up, or is everyone already late to it? Which investor actually belongs in this round, and which one is only circling?

You answer those in writing. Every piece of work here is a memo. A view, the reasoning underneath it, and the part you are not sure about said out loud. The ones that hold up get published on our LinkedIn, the blog on our site, the newsletter and our X.

You also write for the two audiences we sell to. A family office and a pre seed founder want different things from the same piece of news, and a lot of what you write goes out from the founders' own accounts, in their voice.

You work with the two co-founders directly, and with our Head of Brand once that seat is filled. The org is very flat, so you learn straight from us how we screen, what we pass on and why.

This is a paid internship built to grow into a full time seat. We are looking for someone who already follows this market closely, has opinions about it, and wants to spend the next few years writing about it properly.

What you will own

  • Company memos. Why a company is interesting, who belongs in the round, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

  • Sector work. What is heating up, what is over owned, and the evidence behind both.

  • Investor research. Who is actually active, in what, at what stage, and what they are known for.

  • The published version of all of it, plus the pieces written for family offices and early stage founders that go out from the founders' accounts.

You are a fit if you

  • Already follow this market closely because you enjoy it. You can name the rounds from this quarter and say which ones you think are wrong.

  • Already write and research in this space, and turn that into memos or articles yourself.

  • Get the facts right. A wrong fund name, round size or attribution costs credibility we cannot buy back.

  • Use AI every day, and know where it should go nowhere near your work. Good judgement and taste on where it makes you faster, and where it degrades what you put out.

What we offer

Remote and async.

  • Close contact with the co-founders and our Head of Brand directly.

  • Close contact with our internal team.

  • Our network of highly established investors and the top deals out there.

  • Access to our internal processes, and to how we screen deal flow.

  • Learning very closely from all of us.
