jobs.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
jobs.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Social Media Marketer to own how Abridge grows across social. This is a role for someone who treats social as a performance channel with a funnel behind it: someone who can build an audience from a standing start, run a real experiment cadence, and connect audience growth to outcomes further down the funnel like email capture, content consumption, event registration, pipeline influence, and recruiting.

Abridge is an AI company building in healthcare, and we have the substance to build a meaningful public presence: a product that clinicians use and love, a team of practicing physicians and AI researchers, and a CEO who is himself a practicing cardiologist. Two conversations we should be central to, the AI conversation and the healthcare conversation, are happening every day on social without us in them. What we need is someone who can close that gap deliberately, with a plan, a stack, and a number they're accountable to.

Writing matters in this role. You'll be publishing in the brand voice and in the voices of our executives and clinicians, and the work has to be native and genuinely good. But the hard requirement here is growth: we're looking for a growth operator who writes well, not a writer who also reads dashboards. You'll have editorial and creative partners for the craft, and you'll be the one deciding what to test, what to scale, what to kill, and what any of it did for the business.

This role reports into Growth and partners closely with Creative, Comms, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Events, and Recruiting. You'll own social strategy, channel prioritization, distribution, experimentation, and measurement end to end.

What You'll Do

  • Own audience growth as a number. Set and hit targets for follower growth, reach, and engaged audience by platform, and own the framework that connects social activity to ToFu, MoFu, and BoFu outcomes. Be able to say what a month of work produced and what you'd do differently next month.

  • Build and own the measurement layer. Define the metrics that matter, instrument the tracking (UTM discipline, analytics, self-reported attribution, event and campaign tagging), and report to marketing leadership on a regular cadence. Bring insights back that change what we make.

  • Run a continuous experiment program. Maintain a live backlog of hypotheses across hooks, formats, cadence, first frames and thumbnails, posting time, cross-posting, and audience targeting. Design tests that can actually be read, and be disciplined about killing what doesn't work.

  • Decide which platforms we play on and how. Own LinkedIn and X as our primary channels, and make the call on where else we should be investing across Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, TikTok, etc. Each one has a different audience, algorithm, and reason to exist for us.

  • Build the growth stack outside the native platforms. Stand up and operate the tooling that makes growth repeatable: publishing and scheduling, audience research and enrichment, listening and monitoring, link tagging, competitive and creator tracking, reporting. Automate the parts that should be automated, with clear judgment about where third-party tooling crosses a line we don't want to cross as a healthcare company.

  • Use paid amplification where organic hits a ceiling. Partner with Growth to put budget behind what's working, run retargeting off social audiences, and understand the interplay between organic reach and paid distribution.

  • Build an employee and executive amplification program that runs as a system. Identify the right internal voices among our clinicians, researchers, executives, and subject-matter experts, and build the operating model that keeps them posting: content supply, drafting support, approval flow, tooling, and measurable reach. Success here is a program that works without you writing every post.

  • Publish at a high standard and at real volume. Write, edit, ship, and iterate across posts, threads, carousels, comments, executive content, short-form video, and emerging formats. Know when something needs polish and when speed and native execution matter more.

  • Identify the stories worth distributing. Proactively find what's worth posting across the company (product launches, customer impact, research, clinicians, events, cultural moments, the people building Abridge) and bring a strong point of view on the angle and the channel.

  • Partner with Creative to get assets made. Brief designers, writers, videographers, and agencies with clear strategic and creative context. Contribute to ideation, give useful feedback, and treat creative partners as collaborators.

  • Build community. Reply with intention, surface customer and community voices, participate where our audiences actually are, and create real-time moments around launches and flagship events.

  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Incorporate AI throughout your workflow, from audience research and ideation to drafting, editing, repurposing, analysis, and reporting. Experiment with new tools and workflows, and have a considered view on where AI makes the work better and where it doesn't.

  • Partner across marketing and the company. Work alongside Growth, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Events. Bring a distribution and audience perspective into planning early, and turn company priorities into social opportunities.

What You'll Bring

  • Five to eight years in social media marketing or growth marketing, with direct hands-on ownership of social as a growth channel.

  • A demonstrated track record of growing an audience, with real numbers attached. You can walk through what the account looked like when you started, where it got to, and specifically what drove it.

  • Fluency with the funnel. You've been held accountable to metrics beyond engagement, and you can explain how you connected social activity to downstream outcomes like email signups, registrations, demo requests, or pipeline, including where the attribution was imperfect and how you worked around it.

  • Analytics and attribution chops. You're comfortable in platform analytics and in tools like GA4 or Amplitude, you're rigorous about tagging and tracking, and you can build a report that leadership actually uses.

  • Hands-on fluency across multiple platforms, including LinkedIn and X, plus real working knowledge of at least a couple of others (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and TikTok). You understand the cultural, algorithmic, and creative differences between them and can create natively for each.

  • Experience with the tooling layer around social. You've built or automated workflows for publishing, audience research, listening, enrichment, or reporting, and you have a point of view on which tools are worth it and which create more risk than value.

  • Experience running paid social, even at modest budget, and an understanding of how paid and organic compound.

  • Strong writing and editorial judgment. You can find the hook, write an opening line that earns attention, develop an idea clearly, and edit your own work. You don't need to be the best writer on the marketing team, but you need to be good enough that nothing waits on someone else to make it publishable.

  • Experience building executive, employee, or subject-matter-expert voices. You've helped people become credible public voices and can speak specifically to what made the program work and how you kept it running.

  • An AI-native working style. You use AI every day, have considered opinions about where it strengthens the work and where it weakens it, and actively experiment with new tools and workflows.

  • Experience inside a high-growth technology or AI company, where priorities move quickly and you're often creating structure where none exists.

  • Exceptional execution. You're comfortable moving fast, making decisions with incomplete information, and shipping consistently.

  • Strong cross-functional influence. You can bring people together around a point of view and move work forward without formal authority.

  • A proactive, low-ego mindset. You're curious, generous with your expertise, and motivated by work that compounds.

Bonus Points

  • You've grown a personal presence on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok to a meaningful following.

  • You've grown an audience in a regulated or specialized industry, where credibility is built slowly and mistakes are expensive.

  • You've built communities: Slack groups, subreddits, newsletters, events.

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or selling to clinical audiences.

Working at Abridge

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of working from our San Francisco or NYC office a minimum of three days per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates who are willing to move to San Francisco or NYC.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.excerpt: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Check out this Loom video for more details: We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

Nice to have

jobs.excerpt: About UsBy transitioning from a traditional B2B publisher into a modern data authority, Life Science Connect is redefining industry standards.
jobs.description:
About Us

By transitioning from a traditional B2B publisher into a modern data authority, Life Science Connect is redefining industry standards. We specialize in constructing dedicated platforms, identity frameworks, and intelligence layers engineered to speed up development for life sciences experts. Our strategic investments in decoupled modern architecture and AI-enhanced engineering workflows empower our teams to rapidly deploy scalable, premium-quality products.

The Mission
We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst who excels at bridging product strategy, engineering, data, and AI-augmented development.
Forget traditional requirements-gathering roles that focus heavily on meeting notes and passing off tickets. In this position, you will be deeply integrated into a high-velocity engineering organization, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, DevOps, and UX to turn strategic concepts into precise, actionable technical architectures. As a force multiplier for the engineering team, you will decode complex business challenges into clear, implementation-ready specifications, utilize AI tools to expedite analysis, and maximize the time engineers spend writing code rather than untangling ambiguity.

Why This Role Matters

As Life Science Connect evolves into a modern data authority, our ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality depends on exceptional product definition and technical clarity. The Senior IT Business Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring engineers spend their time building innovative solutions—not deciphering requirements.
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, partnering closely with engineers, embracing AI as a productivity multiplier, and helping shape the next generation of intelligent digital products, we'd love to meet you.


What You'll Actually Do

  • Translate Strategy into Engineering Execution: Partner with Product Leadership and Engineering to transform strategic initiatives into clear technical requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, and acceptance criteria that engineers can immediately build from.
  • Drive AI-Augmented Analysis: Use modern AI tools to rapidly produce requirements, process models, technical documentation, and data mappings while maintaining exceptional structural accuracy and logical consistency.
  • Design Intelligent Product Workflows: Analyze complex business processes and design scalable workflows that leverage identity, personalization, analytics, AI services, and customer intelligence across our product ecosystem.
  • Own Product Specifications: Produce implementation-ready documentation including PRDs, functional specifications, user stories with rigorous acceptance criteria, API contracts, process flows, and data mappings.
  • Partner Deeply with Engineering: Work directly alongside Full Stack Engineers to clarify requirements, answer implementation questions, refine technical solutions, and remove ambiguity before development begins.
  • Enable Data Intelligence: Collaborate with Data Engineering to define modern data models, ingestion patterns, warehouse requirements, reporting needs, and customer intelligence workflows while ensuring data quality throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Validate What We Build: Support testing, feature validation, and release readiness by ensuring delivered functionality aligns perfectly with business objectives and technical specifications.
  • Improve How We Work: Continuously improve documentation standards, Agile practices, AI-enabled delivery workflows, and product discovery processes to help the entire engineering organization move faster with greater confidence.


What We're Looking For

5+ Years of Business Analysis Experience

You've worked closely with engineering teams building SaaS platforms, digital products, or enterprise applications and know how to bridge business needs with technical execution.

Technical Fluency

You don't need to write production code, but you're thoroughly comfortable discussing and documenting:
  • REST APIs and JSON payload structures
  • Headless CMS architectures and decoupled front-ends
  • Identity, Authentication, and Customer Identity frameworks (CIAM)
  • Relational and modern cloud data models (Snowflake)
  • Event Tracking, telemetry, and Customer Journey Analytics
  • Cloud-based application architectures and system integrations
Experience with Next.js, React, or modern JavaScript frameworks is a strong plus.


AI-Augmented Analyst

You actively use AI to scale your daily output—not just for generating text, but as a technical sparring partner for requirements generation, gap analysis, user story refinement, edge-case discovery, and workflow optimization. You know how to engineer effective prompts, but more importantly, you possess the critical engineering mindset required to validate, audit, and correct AI outputs before they reach production teams.

Core Traits

  • Product Mindset: You naturally ask "why" before "what." You understand that every requirement should tie directly to customer value, operational efficiency, measurable business outcomes, or revenue growth.
  • Systems Thinker: You enjoy untangling complex processes, identifying hidden technical dependencies, simplifying workflows, and designing scalable architectural solutions.
  • Excellent Communicator: You can confidently facilitate alignment between executives, business stakeholders, designers, engineers, and data teams while effortlessly adapting your communication style to your audience.
  • Highly Autonomous: You excel in distributed teams where asynchronous documentation, radical ownership, proactive communication, and independent problem-solving are essential.


Preferred Experience

  • Agile/Scrum product development in highly iterative environments
  • Technical Business Analysis within cloud-native software engineering organizations
  • Headless CMS platforms (Optimizely preferred)
  • Snowflake or modern cloud-native data platforms
  • Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) systems
  • Product analytics, event streaming, and customer journey mapping
  • API integration, contract design, and webhook architecture
  • AI-assisted software delivery tools and prompts
  • Jira, Confluence, and structured ticket workflows
  • Lucidchart, Miro, or similar visual modeling tools


Success in Your First 90 Days

You'll know you're succeeding when you have:
  • Built trusted, seamless relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, and DevOps.
  • Produced implementation-ready specifications that measurably reduce engineering clarification and rework cycles.
  • Accelerated delivery velocity through high-fidelity, AI-assisted documentation and rapid analysis workflows.
  • Elevated the quality and consistency of product requirements, downstream testing logic, and acceptance criteria.
  • Contributed directly to launching customer-facing features with clear, trackable business impact.
  • Established repeatable documentation, mapping, and analysis practices that scale natively with our engineering organization.

We Invest in YOU
At Life Science Connect, our commitment to empowering innovation and facilitating growth within the life sciences sector extends to our employees. We offer a comprehensive total compensation program designed to support your overall health, financial well-being, and professional development.
In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy:
● Medical/vision/prescription/dental coverage for you and your family
● 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance
● 100% company-paid life insurance
● 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%
● 15 vacation days and 6 personal days on day 1
● 13 company-paid holidays

To view all our job postings and showcases for some of our employees, visit:

Principals only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.

Governance, Safety & ModelOps

jobs.excerpt: 🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission:
We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision:
We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

As the Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.

This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

• Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.

• Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.

People Operations:

• People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align

ed with the company's growth objectives.

• Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.

• Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.

• Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

• Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.

• External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.

How Success Is Measured

Talent Acquisition KPIs:

• Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days.

• Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants.

• Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time.

• Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+.

• Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year.

People Operations KPIs:

• Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale.

• Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement.

• Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment.

• Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are equally comfortable defending the company on Glassdoor as you are building a 90-day onboarding plan. You thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first, contractor-centric environment and have a track record of both filling open roles ahead of timeline and scaling the people systems that retain the talent you bring in.

You Have / Requirements

Talent Acquisition / Recruiting (must-haves):

• 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or e-commerce organizations.

• Proven track record of hiring across marketing, ops, Amazon, product, and leadership roles.

• Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and group interviews.

• Familiarity with recruiting tech stacks: LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, OnlineJobs.ph.

• Comfortable managing hiring systems using Notion, ClickUp, or lightweight ATS tools.

• Strong writing ability: clear job posts, compelling outreach, direct candidate comms.

• Ability to handle 5-10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process.

• Experience defending brand reputation and responding to feedback (e.g. Glassdoor).

• Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics.

People Operations (must-haves):

• 5+ years of progressive HR or people operations experience, with leadership responsibility.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

• Direct experience operating contractor-centric or distributed teams.

• Demonstrated success building compliant, scalable people systems.

• Strong understanding of contractor classification, employment law, and risk mitigation.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.
  • Benefits:
    • Remote-first work environment
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Access to learning resources and professional development
    • Free access to Hadley Designs products
    • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO
    • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Apply Today

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in a growing company that’s shaping the future of learning, apply now to join the Hadley Designs team as our Director of Distributed Team Operations. Help us create a lasting impact on families, educators, and children worldwide.

P.S: If you don’t hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Job Description - Product Manager

Reports To: SVP of Product

Department: Product Management

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

As a Product Manager at AxisCare, you will own the discovery, shaping, and delivery of features across our home care platform. This role sits at the center of our product organization: you have enough experience to drive initiatives independently, and the judgment to know when to escalate or align.

At AxisCare, AI isn’t a tool we experiment , but how we work. Every PM on our team uses AI-assisted tools as a core part of their daily practice: shaping requirements, accelerating research, prototyping, and validating ideas faster than traditional methods allow. We expect PMs to be fluent in these tools and to actively push the boundaries of what’s possible with them.

You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter to customers and move the business forward.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own defined product areas end-to-end — from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, and adoption.
  • Use AI-assisted tools daily to draft requirements, prototype concepts, explore edge cases, and accelerate the path from customer problem to validated

    solution.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs through direct engagement, collaboration with Customer Success and Support, and ongoing analysis of usage data.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to understand prospect needs and translate market signals into product opportunities.
  • Write clear, well-reasoned product requirements and user stories in partnership with Engineering and UX.
  • Build and maintain roadmaps for your product area, communicating priorities and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.
  • Lead go-to-market preparation for your features — including enablement materials, release documentation, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Track adoption and performance metrics post-launch and use findings to inform next iterations.
  • Participate in customer calls, industry events, and prospect discussions as a product representative.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 2–4 years of product management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a product area independently — defining problems, driving decisions, and seeing work through to measurable outcomes.
  • Strong fluency with AI-assisted tools and genuine enthusiasm for working in an AI-forward environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to align cross-functional teams around a clear problem and plan.
  • Analytical mindset — comfortable with data, metrics, and using evidence to inform decisions.
  • Strong collaboration skills with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market teams.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Willingness to travel up to 15% as needed.
  • Proficiency with product and development tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field or equivalent professional experience.

What We'd Be Excited to Find (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in home care, healthcare, or a related industry.

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.
  • Utilization of software and email to perform job functions.
  • Will need to conduct camera-on videoconferencing for customer calls.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Medical insurance premiums are covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision) 
  • 401K with competitive company matching.
  • Personal time off, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more userfriendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 7 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

jobs.excerpt: The CompanyEXADS is an international ad-tech software start-up.
jobs.description:
The Company

EXADS is an international ad-tech software start-up. In business since 2013, we're self-sufficient, well-funded and privately owned, with offices in Dublin and Porto, and part of the wider EXOGROUP (headquartered in Barcelona, with an office in Valencia - 200+ people).

We actively develop and maintain our own proprietary ad-serving platform and custom-built infrastructure, enabling us to innovate and ship new features quickly in a fast-moving, demanding industry. We're revolutionising online ad-serving for advertisers, publishers and networks alike.

Role:

As we scale, we need a Technical Success Manager who bridges the gap between our sophisticated technology and our clients' success. You'll make complex technology accessible, reduce support burden, and empower clients and colleagues alike to understand, and get the most from our platform. You'll be expected to manage a dynamic workload, work to SLAs, prioritising effectively, sometimes under pressure, and finding creative solutions.

This is a start-up style environment, not a large support function. You'll regularly be handed technical problems, which are not fully documented, often with no established playbook, and be expected to investigate and make a genuine start yourself, using the platform, the tooling and your own judgement, drawing on your relevant experience, before pulling in engineering; we'll support you with a company Claude subscription. You don't need to be a software developer, but this is a hands-on technical role: if you've never touched a query, a console log or version control, it isn't the right fit. If you prefer fully-documented processes and a clear signposted path for everything before you begin, this isn't the role. If a small, fast-moving team where you own problems end-to-end excites you without the fear of making mistakes, you'll thrive.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own, investigate and solve technical problems independently, making decisions with little or no guidance where required, and attempting to resolve issues before escalating (in many cases).
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, including RTB reporting and impression discrepancies, reasoning about why they arise in the first place and driving them to resolution with clients and developers.
  • Be the go-to technical point of contact for the team, making EXADS easier for both clients and colleagues to understand.
  • Author and maintain internal process documentation for the team to follow, and provide critical feedback to Product on existing client-facing documentation (Product owns the client docs; you help make them accurate and clear).
  • Support the Sales team in winning new business, and relay complex technical concepts clearly to the team, clients and leads.Prioritise, escalate or directly resolve support tickets, working consistently to define SLAs.
  • Provide visibility and updates on the most important ongoing issues, and establish scalable processes that uplift productivity and efficiency for EXADS and its clients.
  • Liaise with developers and product to request new features, report bugs, ask questions, document issues accurately and escalate issues where necessary, taking ownership to report back to the client on resolutions.
  • Assist in setting up and deploying new platforms for clients, including enabling new ad formats, features, payment methods, and connecting campaigns/zones.
  • Mentor other team members, helping them understand and interpret technical data.
  • Initiate and lead client calls and video meetings with confidence, asking sharp, leading diagnostic questions of both clients and developers to troubleshoot effectively.
  • Develop deep, hands-on knowledge of our product lines, roadmap and ad-network platform, commercial and technical, and how to implement changes.
  • When you do escalate to engineering you ask relevant questions to stakeholders to reduce resolution time.

What you bring:

  • A self-starter mentality with strong organisation. You proactively keep your own records so tasks are easy to replicate and improve, and you teach yourself what you don't yet know rather than waiting to be shown.
  • Comfortable getting hands-on with the technical/data layer. You're not dependent on someone else to interpret it for you.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control, and with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), including using browser developer tools/console logs to review data and diagnose issues.
  • Confidence in communicating with clients and developers alike, leading meetings, asking the right questions, and translating between the two.
  • Strong written, spoken and interpersonal communication skills (English), with the ability to produce clear, concise documentation.A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to communicate across Jira, HubSpot, Slack and GitHub.
  • Excellent understanding of the online advertising industry.
  • Experience working with APIs and an understanding of how they're called and used.
  • Working SQL literacy: you can write, read and interpret queries, understand relational concepts (joins, filters, schema), and modify existing ones with reasoning. You won't need production-grade SQL, but you must be comfortable working in the data layer.
  • A solid technical background focused on web technologies, and genuine problem-solving instinct: you make a start on undocumented problems and use the tools available (including AI tooling) to work them out.

Considered a plus:

  • Hands-on experience with other ad-serving platforms (e.g. Kevel, Google Ad Manager or similar) is highly desirable.
  • Experience with AI models and tooling beyond chatting with LLMs, and familiarity with Claude Code, Codex or similar.
  • Experience delivering technical training and webinars.
  • Experience configuring HubSpot automations and using HubSpot Service Desk.
  • Previous GitHub projects you have worked on or contributed to.
  • Experience supporting and communicating with clients on a SaaS online platform.
  • Coding experience.
  • Experience with RTB technology.

What we offer:

A position in a young, dynamic, international environment, with permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth and a competitive salary based on experience. Critical-skills visa and relocation package available for the right candidate.

Most of all, a team that thrives on achievement, success and industry leadership. Our core value is innovation — people and creativity driving technology. If you enjoy a fast-paced, challenging and rewarding environment and take ownership by instinct, this position is for you.

Experience our benefits:

  • Flexible start times;
  • Summer Schedule;
  • Private health insurance;
  • Remote work from home;
  • Home office set up budget of 500 Euros;
  • Your Birthday off as a paid holiday;
  • Access to quality trainings through Udemy platform;
  • Additional internal and external trainings through our EXOGROUP University program;
  • Up to 1500 Eur of training budget and 5 days of study leave, every year;
  • Flexible compensation of 500 Euros/year;
  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese language lessons;
  • Employee referral program bonus - Earn 2500 Euros by referring someone!
  • Subsidized Well-being activites;
  • Exciting team buildings in locations such as Ibiza;
  • Calm App subscription;
  • Office Perks;
  • Meal card;
  • Relocation Package;

Is this not the right role for you? Then make sure to check out all other roles we have open for you on our careers website.

DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's solution scales infinitely and enables organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine and investigation tools work together to provide guaranteed performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering the total cost of ownership, compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.

Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results driven. Come join us!

As platform engineers, we are building a next-generation machine learning platform, which incorporates our secret sauce, UML (unsupervised machine learning) with other SML (supervised machine learning) algorithms. Our team works to improve our core detection algorithms and automate the full training process.

As complex fraud attacks become more prevalent, it is more important than ever to detect fraudsters in real-time. The platform team is responsible for developing the architecture that makes real-time UML possible. We are looking for creative and eager engineers to help us expand our novel streaming and database systems, which enable our detection capabilities.

We continue to push the boundary of what's possible in fraud detection and data processing at scale. Join us to help usher in more innovative solutions to the fraud detection space.

What you'll do:

Chief of Staff (Strategy & Operations) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and executive leadership team. This is a high-impact leadership role focused on driving company strategy, improving operational execution, aligning cross-functional teams, and ensuring key initiatives move forward efficiently.

This is more than an operations role.

You’ll translate executive priorities into action, lead strategic initiatives, improve business processes, and provide leadership with the visibility needed to make informed decisions. Success in this role requires exceptional business judgment, operational excellence, and the ability to influence across teams without direct authority.

If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments and enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Partner with the CEO to define and execute company strategy.
  • Translate executive priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive accountability across strategic initiatives and company-wide projects.
  • Identify execution risks and recommend proactive solutions.
  • Lead special projects and high-priority business initiatives.

Executive Partnership

  • Support the CEO with prioritization, planning, and decision-making.
  • Prepare executive briefings, presentations, reports, and communications.
  • Assist with board meetings, investor updates, and executive reporting.
  • Represent leadership in meetings and cross-functional initiatives when appropriate.
  • Handle confidential business matters with professionalism and discretion.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Align teams around company objectives and strategic priorities.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration across departments.
  • Lead leadership meetings, follow-up processes, and action-item tracking.
  • Remove operational bottlenecks and improve execution.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Operations & Business Performance

  • Improve internal processes, systems, and operating procedures.
  • Support quarterly planning, annual planning, and business reviews.
  • Develop executive dashboards and performance reporting.
  • Track KPIs, business metrics, and organizational performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and scalability.

Communication & Organizational Alignment

  • Draft executive communications and company-wide updates.
  • Ensure consistent messaging across teams and stakeholders.
  • Support leadership communications related to strategic initiatives and partnerships.
  • Reinforce company culture, organizational alignment, and business priorities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with business goals.
  • Executive leadership operates with greater focus and efficiency.
  • Cross-functional teams remain aligned and accountable.
  • Business reporting provides clear visibility into performance.
  • Operational processes scale effectively alongside company growth.
  • Leadership has timely insight into priorities, risks, and execution.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think strategically while executing with urgency.
  • You solve problems before they become roadblocks.
  • You influence teams without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate confidently with executives and stakeholders.
  • You remain organized while managing multiple high-priority initiatives.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in:
    • Chief of Staff
    • Strategy
    • Operations
    • Business Management
    • Consulting
    • Executive Leadership
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, founders, or executive leadership teams.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and strategic projects.
  • Strong business acumen and operational decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and execution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.

Nice to Have

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience in:
    • High-growth startups
    • Technology companies
    • Consulting firms
    • Scaling organizations
  • Background in:
    • Management Consulting
    • Investment Banking
    • Corporate Strategy
    • Business Operations
  • Experience supporting board reporting and executive planning.
  • Experience leading organizational change and process improvement initiatives.

Tech Stack

  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Google Workspace
  • Project Management Tools
    • Asana
    • Monday.com
    • Notion
    • Similar platforms
  • Executive dashboards and KPI reporting tools
  • CRM and business productivity platforms
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Meet with the CEO to review priorities and strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional projects and leadership action items.
  • Monitor KPIs and business performance dashboards.
  • Prepare executive presentations, reports, and communications.
  • Lead follow-ups on strategic initiatives across departments.
  • Remove execution bottlenecks and improve operational workflows.
  • Support leadership meetings, planning sessions, and business reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organizational efficiency and scalability.

In short: You’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, ensuring company priorities are executed effectively while aligning teams, improving operations, and driving organizational performance.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Strategic initiative completion rate.
  • Executive priority execution.
  • Cross-functional project delivery.
  • KPI reporting accuracy and visibility.
  • Operational efficiency improvements.
  • Stakeholder and leadership satisfaction.
  • Organizational alignment and accountability.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct partnership with the CEO and executive leadership.
  • High ownership over strategy, operations, and company execution.
  • Significant influence on business growth and organizational performance.
  • Exposure to executive decision-making and company-wide initiatives.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career progression into:
    • VP of Operations
    • Chief Operating Officer (COO)
    • General Manager
    • Executive Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience supporting CEOs and executive leadership, and explain how you’ve led strategic initiatives, improved operations, aligned cross-functional teams, and driven organizational execution. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight your leadership style, business judgment, and experience managing high-impact projects in fast-paced environments. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about strategy, operations, executive partnership, and driving meaningful business impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the growth and execution of a high-performing organization.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead the development of a modern, AI-assisted tax filing platform.

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role where you'll design system architecture, build scalable backend services, develop intuitive frontend experiences, and ensure every part of the application is accurate, secure, and production-ready.

You'll own features from concept to deployment, working across both frontend and backend while using AI development tools like Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex engineering problems, takes ownership of technical decisions, and thrives in environments where data accuracy and reliability are critical.

Responsibilities

Full Stack Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable full-stack applications.
  • Develop secure backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces for complex workflows and data entry.
  • Integrate frontend applications seamlessly with backend services.

System Architecture & Engineering

  • Design application architecture, data models, APIs, and service structures that support long-term scalability.
  • Make technical decisions around performance, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Refactor and improve existing systems as the platform evolves.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Use Cursor and Claude Code as part of your daily development workflow.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve productivity, code quality, debugging, and implementation speed.
  • Continuously evaluate opportunities to automate development tasks.

Data Validation & Reliability

  • Implement robust validation logic, business rules, and error handling.
  • Ensure data accuracy across complex workflows and user submissions.
  • Build systems that are secure, reliable, and audit-ready.

Testing & Quality

  • Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Identify and resolve bugs before deployment.
  • Maintain high code quality through testing, documentation, and code reviews.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Own features from planning through deployment.
  • Document technical decisions and communicate progress proactively.
  • Work closely with product stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy solving complex technical problems from end to end.
  • You take ownership of systems rather than simply completing assigned tasks.
  • You build clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • You communicate proactively and work effectively in a remote environment.
  • You embrace AI-assisted development as part of your engineering workflow.
  • You pay close attention to accuracy, especially when working with business-critical data.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of professional Full Stack Software Engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python and FastAPI.
  • Experience designing and building production-grade REST APIs.
  • Strong frontend development experience with modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Experience designing scalable application architecture and data models.
  • Hands-on experience using Cursor and Claude Code in daily development.
  • Experience building workflow-driven or form-heavy applications.
  • Strong understanding of API integration, validation, authentication, and secure data handling.
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building tax, fintech, accounting, compliance, or other highly regulated applications.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and modern deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with relational databases and ORM frameworks.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience working in fully remote engineering teams.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing updates from teammates and planning development priorities. You'll spend most of your time building new features, designing APIs, implementing frontend functionality, and solving complex workflow challenges.

Throughout the day you'll use Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development, write tests, troubleshoot issues, and improve implementation quality.

You'll collaborate with product stakeholders to clarify requirements, document technical decisions, and ensure every feature is accurate, scalable, and ready for production.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Quality and reliability of delivered features
  • API performance and system scalability
  • Code quality and test coverage
  • Accuracy of business logic and validation
  • Timely delivery of development milestones
  • System stability and production reliability
  • Documentation quality
  • Collaboration and ownership

  2. Technical Assessment / AI Evaluation
  3. Client Technical Interview
  4. Offer Stage

It's a short, self-recorded introduction completed on your own time and serves as the final step in completing your application.

This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication skills before moving forward with interviews, making the hiring process faster and more efficient.

As a senior technical leader, you’ll partner closely with engineering, AI, and product teams to drive innovation, define our ML strategy, and mentor others in applying best practices for scalable, responsible AI.

This is both a hands-on and strategic role. You will lead complex, end-to-end ML initiatives—from model design and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—while advancing the evolution of SailPoint’s AI platform, data pipelines, and model governance standards.

About the team:

The AI team at SailPoint applies AI and domain expertise to create AI solutions that solve real problems in identity security. Preferred

  • Experience designing AI platforms or reusable ML services that support multiple product lines.

Reports to: Katie Fortunato, Co-Founder & President Direct Reports: Creator Community & Growth Manager

Compensation: $120k-$170k + bonus

Location: US-based, remote. Open to US travel as needed, estimate about quarterly

About Jobstream™

Jobstream™ is defining a new category at the intersection of the creator economy and talent discovery. We are the first Career Creator network, enabling creators to earn income by helping their audiences discover real jobs. Everything runs through the Career Creator Network™, our community of career creators growing together.

Backed by 25+ years of human capital infrastructure through Hire Innovations, we operate with startup speed and enterprise support. You will report into the Co-Founder and President and be considered part of the founding team. This next year is about going to market, and you will be at the center of it.

We build for the visual world. We show instead of tell. We protect what is human in the job search. And the brand can never fail.

Role Overview

The Head of Growth Marketing owns two sides of the same flywheel: the creator network and the enterprise brand campaigns it powers. Client delivery and fulfillment succeed end to end when creators are thriving, engaged, and earning. That flywheel is yours.

On one side, you own the growth engine: the profile of the brand, creator acquisition across every persona, and the health of the community everything depends on. On the other, you make sure that engine delivers. The team owns campaign execution; you hold them accountable to it, ensuring the community and growth systems work as one flywheel so that when a client campaign needs the network, the network is ready.

You bring proven growth playbooks from ecommerce and digital businesses and apply them to a new category-defining creator platform. Creator monetization runs on these mechanics: conversion funnels, performance data, retention loops, and brand partnerships that renew because they work.

This is a doer's role first and a leader's role second. Our philosophy is simple: we build the systems ourselves, then hire for what we can't do. You architect the playbook and you run it, hands on, and direct and grow the growth marketing function. Your first direct report is the Creator Community & Growth Manager, a creator-native operator who serves as the day-to-day, peer-level face of the community. You set the strategy, priorities, and standard; they bring the lived growth by community credibility. Together you cover the full picture. The leadership path here is earned through building. Stage one: you do the work and build the systems. Stage two: you document the playbooks and delegate what is repeatable. Stage three: you own the full growth function, with a team you shaped across creator acquisition and campaign delivery, and scope that expands as the systems you built prove out. You are creating the standard of excellence from the onset, and the function grows around it.

  • Strong networking fundamentals – Everything below builds on this, and it is not negotiable
  • Deep expertise in routing protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, and static routing, with hands-on experience in route policy design, route redistribution, filtering, and traffic engineering
  • Understanding of network virtualization and software-defined networking, including VRFs, multi-tenant network architectures, SD-WAN, and the encapsulation protocols used to build overlays at scale (GRE, VXLAN, GENEVE and similar)
  • Hands-on experience with IPsec VPNs, encryption standards, NAT, and secure connectivity architectures
  • Good understanding of how enterprises extend cloud connectivity using a variety of Networking Technologies (i.e. Cloud On-Ramps, SD-WAN and IPsec)
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise network design and deployment experience across data center, WAN and hybrid/multi-cloud
  • A deep understanding of network services — DNS, DHCP, load balancing, traffic inspection and similar
  • The ability to troubleshoot live, in front of a customer, across routing, security and cloud domains
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort presenting and demoing to customers in person – In this role you are the technical credibility of the company

Strongly preferred

  • Understanding of cloud networking constructs across AWS, Azure, and GCP (e.g., VPCs/VNets, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, Cloud Router, peering, and hybrid connectivity such as Direct Connect and ExpressRoute)
  • Network security expertise, including firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point), firewall policy design, service insertion/chaining, and Zero Trust principles

Alkira, a Lumen Connect® solution, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world's largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you'll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

Research Associate

Location Remote

Business Cohen Veterans Network, Inc.

A Career with Cohen Veterans Network, Inc

At Cohen Veterans Network, we seek to improve the quality of life for veterans, including those from the National Guard and Reserves, active duty, and their families. CVN works to strengthen mental health outcomes and complement existing support. Our vision is to ensure that every veteran, active-duty service member, and family member can obtain access to high-quality care that enables them to lead fulfilling and productive lives. The Cohen Veterans Network, Inc., is a not-for-profit philanthropic organization (a registered 501c3 Private Foundation).

What you will do

We are seeking a post-doctoral research /associate scientist with a focus on quantitative data management and analysis to join our team in a full time permanent position. Under the Deputy Director, Institute for Quality, you will, conduct literature reviews and syntheses, develop research questions to interrogate through CVNs archival and/or prospective data collection mechanisms and methods and will identify and pursue grant funding opportunities to expand and enhance our research portfolio and impact on the field. You will also support internal operations research and quality improvement projects, optimizing clinical care and organizational processes to ensure CVN remains a learning mental health network and advancing the field.

Specifically, you will:

  • Conceptualize proposed research projects based on subject matter knowledge, experience and critical evaluation of existing evidence including the peer reviewed literature
  • Develop and apply a range of analytic techniques and methodologies and research designs; conduct and present analyses of archival and prospective data
    • Conduct EHR-based data extraction, transformation, and analysis using SQL and R and/or Python
    • Support operational analytics needs across clinical programs (e.g., outcomes tracking, measurement-based care, program evaluation)
    • Build reproducible data pipelines and analytic workflows
    • Collaborate with clinical, operational, and data engineering teams to ensure data quality and usability
    • Apply research, data analytic tools, and methodologies to address and resolve clinical and operational challenges/problems in conjunction with the IQ team, other departments and CVN leadership.
    • Support program evaluation efforts and operational projects and studies
  • Translate complex findings into actionable insights for scientific and non-technical audiences
  • Work collaboratively in a multi-disciplinary team to support internal research initiatives, research grants, CVN’s Scientific Advisory Board, and cross-collaboration between CVN-IQ and other departments and clinics in the network
  • Assist in development, review and submission of grant application, research proposals, IRB protocols.
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties or other projects assigned.

What’s required

  • Doctorate, (PhD) in a clinical psychology or related clinical/social science field
  • 5-7 years’ experience (includes doctoral training) in a research institute or academic setting
  • Subject matter knowledge or expertise in clinical or experimental psychology or related field
