jobs.description:
会社概要

弊社は、MITとStanford大学院の卒業生によって2021年4月に創業されたリーガルテック企業です。創業当初からプロダクトへの高い信頼度を武器に、これまでほぼ口コミ・紹介のみで顧客基盤を拡大し、約4年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

結果として、今では日本の5大法律事務所やLINEヤフー社、メルカリ社などをはじめとする、数百の優良顧客へ導入いただいております。また、既に米国や韓国をはじめとする国外へもプロダクトを展開しております。

会社概要

BoostDraftは現在50名規模となり、国内での強固な事業基盤を土台に、APACをはじめとするグローバル展開を本格化させる重要な転換期を迎えています。本ポジションには、COOの右腕として事業全体を俯瞰し、全社視点でのリソース最適化と非連続な成長を牽引する役割を期待しています。戦術的なオペレーションの枠を越え、「どこで、どう勝つか」という純粋な事業戦略を描き、その実行を主導する事業成長の要となっていただきます。そして、中長期的にはJapan Business Headとして、営業、マーケティング、カスタマーサクセスなどの各ビジネス部門を統括し、日本市場における事業成長のトップとして組織を牽引していただくことを想定しています。

想定業務:

  • 経営課題の特定と解決策の実行
    • 事業の成長を阻害している根本的な課題の特定と構造化
    • 各部門（営業、カスタマーサクセス等）を横断する業務プロセスの見直し、および改善プランの策定
    • 策定した戦略に基づく各現場への実行プランの落とし込み、および複数部門を巻き込んだプロジェクトの完遂
  • 日本事業の成長戦略および新規事業の立案
    • データ分析に基づく、既存事業の売上拡大に向けた最も効果的な打ち手の特定と検証
    • 市場調査や顧客へのヒアリングを通じた、新規事業や新機能におけるビジネスモデルの検討
  • 海外拠点との連携およびグローバル展開の支援
    • 韓国や北米のBizOps担当者との連携、およびメンタリング
    • 各国の市場動向や成功事例の統合を通じた、APAC市場への展開戦略の構築
  • 重要顧客・パートナーとの関係構築
    • 大手企業の意思決定層に対する、経営視点での直接的な提案や重要交渉
    • 事業拡大を目的とした他社との戦略的な提携、およびアライアンス交渉への参画
  • 経営の意思決定を支えるデータ分析体制の構築
    • 各部門に散在する事業データの統合、およびKPIの可視化
    • 経営陣が迅速かつ的確な意思決定を行うためのモニタリング体制の整備と運用

※上記はあくまで想定業務となります

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • 創業から約4年間資金調達を行わずに事業拡大をした稀有なスタートアップ環境
  • 優秀な人財に囲まれたチャレンジングな環境 (Microsoft, NTT, BCG出身者等)
  • インターナショナルなチーム環境 (従業員の約半数が外国籍のメンバー)
  • マネジメント層含め、小さなお子様を抱えているメンバーも活躍中

Requirements

必須経験/スキル -

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力、およびネイティブレベルの日本語力

また、下記のいずれか一つ

  • 戦略コンサルティングファーム、または総合系コンサルティングファームでの実務経験（マネージャー等、プロジェクトリードの経験を想定）
  • スタートアップ企業（数十名〜百名規模）における事業開発、経営企画、またはBizOps等の実務経験

歓迎経験/スキル

  • B2B ソフトウェア領域における事業成長の知見
  • グローバルチーム、または多国籍なメンバーとの協働・マネジメント経験

求める人物像

  • 「自ら手を動かすこと」を厭わず、カオスな環境を楽しめるハンズオン志向
  • 「第二創業期」のスピード感と変化を楽しみ、自ら課題解決に取り組める強いオーナーシップを持つ方。
  • 策定した戦略を、他部門を巻き込みながら粘り強く実行し、成果につなげる高いコミットメント力。
  • 自律的に高いパフォーマンスを発揮しつつ、グローバルチームへの貢献を欠かさない方。

Benefits

jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.
AHEAD is seeking a Senior Technical Consultant to join the Enterprise Networking team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise network solutions across routing, switching, BGP-based enterprise and WAN architectures, wireless, and network access control environments. The ideal candidate brings strong consulting presence, deep technical expertise, and hands-on experience delivering network infrastructure projects for enterprise clients.

Key Responsibilities

    · Design and implement enterprise network solutions across campus, branch, and datacenter environments

    · Lead technical discovery, architecture, design workshops, and deployment activities for client engagements

    · Develop high-quality low-level and high-level design documentation, implementation plans, and test plans

    · Configure, validate, and troubleshoot routing and switching platforms in complex production environments

    · Perform wireless site surveys, predictive designs, and post-deployment validation using Ekahau

    · Design and implement enterprise wireless solutions with a focus on coverage, capacity, roaming, and performance

    · Deploy and support Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control, authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement

    · Provide technical leadership during implementation, migration, cutover, and optimization activities

    · Collaborate with project managers, architects, engineers, and client stakeholders to ensure successful delivery

    · Mentor junior consultants and contribute to technical best practices within the enterprise networking team

    · Support pre-sales efforts through solution reviews, level-of-effort input, and technical recommendations

Required Qualifications

    · Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related experience

    · Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise network solutions

    · CCNP certification required, with strong focus on routing, switching, and BGP

    · Strong knowledge of BGP design, implementation, policy control, path selection, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments

    · CWNA certification required

    · Proven network design experience in enterprise environments

    · Hands-on experience with enterprise routing and switching platforms, including Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switches, protocols, and architectures

    · Hands-on experience conducting wireless surveys and wireless design using Ekahau

    · Experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting enterprise wireless networks

    · Experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) deployments and policy-based access control

    · Strong understanding of LAN, WAN, WLAN, TCP/IP, VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP, OSPF, BGP, QoS, and DHCP/DNS fundamentals

    · Ability to create clear technical documentation, diagrams, implementation plans, and client deliverables

    · Strong communication, presentation, and customer-facing consulting skills

    · Ability to manage multiple priorities across project-based work

Preferred Qualifications

    · CWNE certification preferred

    · Experience with enterprise network assessments, refreshes, migrations, and greenfield deployments

    · Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Arista, Aruba, and Juniper switching and wireless platforms

    · Experience with Meraki wireless platforms preferred

    · Experience integrating ISE with wired and wireless access environments

    · Experience working in a consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery role

    · Additional relevant certifications in enterprise networking or wireless technologies

    This role requires strong experience designing and implementing enterprise networks, with particular emphasis on routing, switching, BGP, wireless, and network access control. Candidates must hold a CCNP focused on routing and switching and a CWNA, with CWNE preferred. The ideal candidate has at least 4 years of experience, hands-on Ekahau wireless survey and design expertise, and Cisco ISE experience in enterprise environments.

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 andwe are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

  • Core Accounts:We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

  • Account Intelligence:We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

  • Account Cohort and Verification Automation:Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

  • Spend Attribution:We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • 7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

  • 4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

  • Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

  • Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

  • Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

  • Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

  • Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

  • Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts, security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Live Ads Supply
jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Sincelaunchingour ad-supported tier in 2022, the momentum has been unstoppable—we reach over94 millionglobal monthly active users! As we enter ourfourth year, our ambition is massive, and we are just getting started.

About The Team

The Live Ad Insertions team sits at the intersection of broadcast engineering, streaming infrastructure, and digital advertising. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, high-reliability ad insertion experience across live and linear streams, from primetime tentpole events like the NFL and live sports to 24/7 linear feeds and breaking news. We own the full stack of tools, systems, and operational infrastructure required to trigger, stitch, monitor, and verify ad breaks in real time at scale, without compromising the member experience.

Live advertising is one of the highest-stakes, highest-reward surfaces in CTV. When tens of millions of concurrent viewers are watching a single event, there are no second chances. A break happens once, in real time, and the window to act is measured in seconds. That demands more than reliable systems: it demands proactive observability tooling that can detect anomalies before they surface to members, and the ability to make real-time corrections mid-event when something does go wrong. This team operates with the precision of a broadcast NOC and the velocity of a software startup. We are responsible for the technology that turns a live signal into a monetized ad experience, at scale, millisecond by millisecond.

As an Engineering Manager, You Will

Lead a team of engineers building the real-time infrastructure, tooling, and operational systems for live ad insertion across server-side, client-side, and server-guided delivery models.

  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of ad insertion during 24/7 linear streams and high-stakes live events, including NFL games, live sports, and awards shows.

  • Define the technical roadmap for live ad insertion, including SCTE signal ingestion and validation, ad pod management, manifest stitching, slate handling, and ad decisioning integration.

  • Partner with ad operations, broadcast engineering, content delivery, and ad serving teams to ensure seamless signal-to-slot execution from ingest to client playback.

  • Drive hiring, retention, and development of a high-performing engineering team capable of operating in a demanding live environment.

  • Establish the on-call and incident response culture for live ad systems, setting SLAs and runbooks for break-glass scenarios during high-profile live events.

  • Contextualize your team's larger advertising strategy and translate business priorities into a technically sound, executable plan.

  • Serve as the technical authority in cross-functional discussions on live ad capabilities, representing the team to leadership, partners, and vendors.

Skills and Experience We Are Seeking

Technical Skills & Domain Expertise

  • Streaming Pipelines & Architecture:Deep hands-on experience with live streaming pipelines (from ingest protocols like RTMP, SRT, or TS through to CDN) and ad insertion architectures, including SSAI, CSAI, and SGAI (HLS interstitials/DASH).

  • Broadcast Standards & Splicing:Expertise in broadcast signaling (SCTE-35, SCTE-104, SCTE-224) and manifest manipulation for ad stitching, alongside familiarity with master control and linear playout systems.

  • Ad Pod Construction & Encoding:Advanced knowledge of managing live break constraints, including slate/fallback handling, break reconciliation, and encoding constraints (codec/bitrate matching, frame rate alignment) to prevent playback artifacts.

  • Ad Tech Decisioning:Strong understanding of ad servers, DSPs, and VAST 4.x/VMAP in live contexts, with a focus on managing strict decisioning latency budgets, timeout handling, tracking event firing, and mitigating the cascading effects of decision failures.

  • Operational Tooling:Proven track record of engineering for high-availability, zero-downtime live events, including building operational tooling for ad ops (e.g., real-time fill rate tracking, signal health visualization, and break monitoring workflows).

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • 10+ years of total engineering experience with 3+ years managing software engineering teams in a live media, streaming, or ad tech context.

  • Strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers in competitive talent markets.

  • Ability to operate in a flat, fast-moving organization, balancing long-term architectural investments against immediate operational needs.

  • Effective communicator across both technical and business stakeholders, including ad sales, ad operations, broadcast engineering, and executive leadership.

  • Experience collaborating with content and distribution partners, including MVPDs, vMVPDs, and broadcast networks, on joint live ad insertion implementations.

To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. This senior technical leadership role will define and drive the architecture of the data center IT Module (white space), including high-density power distribution, cooling integration, rack infrastructure, modular deployment strategies, and pod-level system design. Be highly knowledgeable about Eaton's products, services, general business, structure, strategy, and operations. Articulate this knowledge in terms of value to the client's business.

Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting Eaton within the client engineering organization.

Build a multi-lane bridge between Eaton and the client organization. This may include GPL leaders, Engineering leaders, Product line managers, BU Engineers, BDM, Marketing, PMO, Services, Sales Operations & Order Management, Supply Chain, Leadership & Executive Management.

Leadership & experience: 15+ years in critical power system design and electrical distribution engineering (advanced degree strongly preferred).

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent recognized qualification
Minimum of 10 years of related experience in the data center business across core domains of whitespace, cooling, power, fiber, controls, and rack systems

jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

At Netflix, we want to entertain the world and are constantly innovating on how entertainment is imagined, created, and delivered to a global audience. Engineering teams within Netflix work hard every day to scale and innovate content production and member experiences in an ever-growing complex software landscape.

Our Content & Business Products (CBP) Engineering teams build the products and services to optimize and automate the content creation process including content planning, financing, production, promotion, and distribution. We support Netflix's enterprise needs including Finance, Talent, Tech Support, and Customer Support to ensure smooth operations.Our products enable the entire workflow of content production, from pitch to play, and provide innovative new ways to develop and manage entertainment at scale. The team’s work is critical to supporting the creation of movies and TV series that will thrill the world!

Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience crafting resilient, high-scale, low-latency, distributed microservices in production environments.

  • Proficient with gRPC, GraphQL, or RESTful API design and implementation.

  • Have recent proficient experience with Java, C#, or other OO programming languages with a solid understanding of OO design principles, concurrency, multi-threading, performance tuning, and observability.

  • Have a proven track record in architecting, building, and operating distributed systems with high availability, fault tolerance, and performance.

  • Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

  • Have the ability to proactively describe complex technical concepts to a variety of stakeholders, driving conversations and decisions through written and/or verbal communication.

  • Participate in our on-call rotation and lead the incident reviews.

What Sets You Apart

  • Curious about a broad range of new or unfamiliar technologies, the consumer base, and product vision.

  • Seek different perspectives, feedback, and relevant information to continuously grow and improve.

  • Maintain strong relationships with cross-functional teams through clear communication.

  • Take a thoughtful, practical approach to problem-solving that considers tradeoffs and avoids over-engineering.

  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking knowledge in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.

  • Endeavor to elevate the knowledge, skills, and abilities of yourself and others that are conducive to fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment.

  • You leverage AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle.

  • You actively seek out and vet new AI-driven development tools to boost overall team productivity and operational efficiency.

Spotlight on CBP Engineering Teams:

Creative Workflows

The Media Production Suite (MPS) Creative Workflows team sits at the intersection of filmmaking, large‑scale distributed systems, and generative AI. We build cloud‑native pipelines that transform petabytes of raw camera footage from sets worldwide into secure, high‑quality, color/sound/framing‑accurate deliverables that creatives rely on—typically within hours of shooting (these are the “dailies”). Dailies have traditionally been managed by human operators; we’re rethinking that end‑to‑end, using automation and generative AI in every part of the workflow—from intelligent metadata extraction and quality checks to smarter routing, prioritization, and review experiences.

Localization Technology

The Logistics Management squad is the operational backbone of Netflix's localization platform. We own the tools, workflows, and infrastructure through which every piece of content is ordered, tracked, fulfilled, and paid for — across 2,700 weekly internal users and 180+ external vendors. Our role is to build the platform layer that makes AI-first localization possible. The 18-24 month vision is to automate 70-80% of localization workflows so that human effort shifts from execution to governance and the highest-impact decisions. We are the team that makes that shift real: every workflow we automate, every manual handoff we eliminate, and every vendor dependency we reduce is a step toward localization operating at internet speed. Critically, localization is not downstream of Netflix's content pipeline — it is inside it. Content cannot play for international audiences until it is localized.

Core Catalog

The Core Catalog team creates products that advance Netflix innovation and subscriber offerings. Netflix is no longer just Movies and Shows, it also offers members Games, Live streams, and ad-tier subscriptions. These new content types require large investment in how we manage our catalog and create the systems that enable our business users around the world to set up, promote, and distribute our titles across multiple platforms.

Catalog Foundations & Distribution (CFD)
Members of the Catalog Foundations & Distribution (CFD) team play a pivotal role in delivering new and emerging content to millions of members worldwide! We build the engine behind the Netflix catalog, ensuring that every title and piece of metadata reaches consumer-scale systems cohesively, quickly, and safely. Our work is crucial for enabling engaging canvases, personalized recommendations, and seamless discovery experiences that bring "moments of joy" to our subscribers. As Netflix ventures into exciting new content domains like Live, Games, and Sports, the CFD team is at the forefront, building the critical foundations that accelerate these emerging business initiatives. You'll contribute to improving the speed and stability of our existing metadata systems, ensuring a lean footprint and fast data propagation, while also enhancing our safety features to protect against critical risks. This is an incredible opportunity to work on high-impact areas, driving business velocity and collaborating with partners across Netflix to deliver frequent wins for our stakeholders. If you're passionate about building robust, scalable systems that directly power the Netflix experience, we'd love to have you!

A few more things about us:

As a team, we come from many different countries and our fields of education range from the humanities to engineering to computer science. Our team includes product managers, program managers, designers, full-stack developers, distributed systems engineers, and data scientists. Folks have the opportunity to wear different hats, should they choose to. We strongly believe this diversity has helped us build an inclusive and empathetic environment and look forward to adding your perspective to the mix!

The range for this role is $388,000.00 - $558,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

  • General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.

  • Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.

  • Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

  • Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams:

The Ad Supply teammanages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model. The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement teambuilds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers. Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes.

The Ads Identity and Audience teamis dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy. Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations. We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy teamat Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide.

The Ads Media Planning teamis at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix’s advertising business. We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix’s platform. Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale. We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix’s broader business goals.

The Live Ads Management teamis driving one of Netflix’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events. We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts. We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations teambuilds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management teamis responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem.

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting teambuilds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization.

The Ads Data Clean Room teamis redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing teambuilds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations. The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board. This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows.

The Ads Reporting Infrastructure teamis responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders. Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes. They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results.

The Ads CRM teamdelivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing. We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness. Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Product Lead Engineer serves as the technical authority across multiple Agile scrum teams inside a vertical product. While this role carries no personnel management responsibilities, the Product Lead Engineer has the highest technical voice within the team — setting direction, making implementation calls, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, well-engineered software. Beyond their own contributions, their output raises the technical capability of everyone around them.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1.Technical Team Leadership

  • Serve as the technical authority within the development teams, making implementation decisions, resolving technical disagreements, and ensuring the team operates to a consistently high engineering standard.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex features across backend, frontend, and mobile platforms — from design through deployment and monitoring — while actively guiding teammates through their portions of the work.
  • Decompose ambiguous requirements into well-scoped tasks for the team, and proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
  • Regularly and actively contribute production code — this is a player-coach role. The Product Lead Engineer is expected to be a consistent, high-quality committer and to model the engineering standards to which the rest of the organization is held.

2.Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve quality and accelerate the growth of junior engineers.
  • Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, design discussions, and regular technical guidance.
  • Drive best practices for testing, branching, documentation, and security within the team.

3.Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements, estimate accurately, and deliver reliable features on schedule.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively about technical risks, progress, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

4.Technical Ownership & Cross-Training

  • Take primary ownership of one or more significant product areas — maintaining deep expertise in their architecture, behavior, and failure modes, and serving as the authoritative resource for decisions and issues in those areas.
  • Proactively lead knowledge transfer of your owned areas to teammates, ensuring the team can operate effectively without you and no single engineer becomes a bottleneck.
  • Actively participate in cross-training led by others, developing meaningful familiarity with product areas outside your primary ownership to strengthen overall team resilience.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Technical Quality

  • Code, designs, and architectural decisions within the domain consistently meet peer review standards without significant rework.
  • Technical debt and reliability risks in areas of ownership trend downward over time.

Delivery & Reliability

  • Complex features are delivered on schedule with accurate estimation; risks are surfaced early with proposed mitigations.
  • Production incidents in areas of ownership are resolved rapidly with durable root cause fixes.

Organizational Impact

  • Software Engineers who regularly work with this role demonstrably improve in code quality and technical judgment.
  • Technical recommendations are trusted by peers and leads without requiring repeated validation.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ambiguous requirements are clarified and decomposed without waiting for direction.
  • Feedback given in code reviews and design discussions is specific, actionable, and consistently improves the work.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including production SaaS environments.
  • Deep proficiency in PHP and JavaScript/React, including design patterns, performance, and security best practices.
  • Strong command of relational database design, SQL optimization, and data modeling (MySQL/MariaDB).
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and upskill less experienced engineers.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • 7+ years of professional software development with full-stack ownership in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with cloud architecture on AWS (IaaS/PaaS) including serverless and managed databases.
  • Experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile development.
  • Working knowledge of security benchmarks: OWASP, CIS, SOC2.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.

jobs.title: Senior GPU Raytracing Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team. This hire will lead the design and implementation of a real‑time, GPU‑accelerated propagation engine that predicts how radio signals travel through realistic 3‑D environments — producing both per‑link channel characterisations and radio maps at the speed required by production RAN stacks! This position offers the opportunity to work on foundational technology for 5G and 6G network simulation, using NVIDIA's world‑class GPU and ray‑tracing platforms.

What you'll be doing:

As a member of NVIDIA's Aerial team, you will architect and implement a GPU ray‑tracing engine that operates at two time scales. At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in computer graphics, high‑performance computing, computational electromagnetics, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Hands‑on proficiency with CUDA and at least one GPU ray‑tracing framework (OptiX, Vulkan RT, Embree), with a track record of writing production‑quality GPU code.

  • Proficiency in GPU‑friendly spatial data structures (BVH, space‑filling curves, hash maps) and the ability to reason about memory hierarchy, occupancy, and compute‑vs‑bandwidth trade‑offs at the kernel level.

  • Working knowledge of electromagnetic wave propagation phenomena (reflection, transmission, diffraction, scattering) sufficient to implement and validate a propagation engine.

  • Impactful publications in GPU ray tracing, real‑time rendering, or deterministic propagation modelling.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with real‑time or near‑real‑time ray‑tracing engines shipping in production systems.

  • Prior work on multi‑GPU partitioning for ray‑tracing or large‑scale simulation workloads.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP channel models and wireless network planning tools.

  • Knowledge of geospatial coordinate systems and tiling schemes.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionGreat underwriters know that the best decisions come from blending analytical thinking with real market instincts.
jobs.description:
Description

Great underwriters know that the best decisions come from blending analytical thinking with real market instincts. If you thrive on the challenge of growing a book of business, building influential broker relationships, and making your mark in a specialty vertical, this is your opportunity.

As a Senior Underwriter in Liberty Mutual's Healthcare & Life Sciences Practice Group — a specialized unit within Major Accounts — you will underwrite Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, and General Liability (non-products) across all program structures with a primary emphasis on loss-sensitive accounts. You will partner with Loss Control, Industry Consulting, and Claims to deepen your expertise in the healthcare and life sciences sectors while driving profitable growth.

This is a range posting for a Senior or Executive-level Underwriter, depending upon experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Book of Business Development: Develop, grow, and maintain a profitable, diversified book of primary casualty business through sound underwriting decisions, strong agent/broker relationships, and effective use of underwriting tools and resources. Mentor less experienced underwriters in technical and professional skills.
  • Risk Selection: evaluates opportunities by qualifying accounts; identifying, selecting and assessing risks; determining the premium, policy terms and conditions; obtaining approvals; creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Market to an assigned territory targeting healthcare and life science accounts. Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers through responsive service, site visits, and in-person meetings. Partner across markets deliver holistic account solutions.
  • Portfolio Management: Analyze and manage a complex book of business, identifying opportunities for growth, profit improvement, and diversification. Execute targeted marketing plans and use pricing models to ensure portfolio profitability.
  • Service Value Proposition: Clearly articulate the specialized services Liberty Mutual offers healthcare insureds relative to competitors..
  • Documenting the Deal: Maintain thorough file documentation that reflects sound decision-making through account reviews, sign-offs, and referrals in compliance with state regulations and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Mentor and coach underwriters on technical and professional skills. Share subject matter expertise and provide regular insights to the broader underwriting team.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively engage in daily huddles, problem-solving activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to support team performance and operational excellence.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business or equivalent typically required. 3 to 7 years of commercial lines underwriting experience preferred, with a proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business.
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred.
  • Analytical ability across all phases of the underwriting process with proficiency in qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques. Must demonstrate knowledge of underwriting, pricing, risk selection, and territory management.

You will partner with a strong leadership team that values accountability, collaboration, and growth. If you enjoy working along top talent, making tough decisions, and being part of a team that takes pride in doing the right thing at the right time, this is a place where you can build something bigger than just your next role.

This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

  • Drive proactive claim outcomes through early investigations and strategic decision making. Own the full claim lifecycle from coverage analysis and reserving to negotiation and resolution – by making timely, well-supported decisions. jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Associate Experience Managerprovides hands-on support for platform experience work across the Revenue Enablement strategic programs portfolio. This role helps improve the seller and partner experience by supporting page readiness, navigation, content organization, stakeholder coordination, adoption activities, and experience quality across key enablement platforms, including The Sales Hub, Mindtickle, and future platform transitions.

This role is designed as an early-career development opportunity with structured support and training from the Platform Experience Leader. The Associate Experience Manager will build experience in digital enablement, content experience, platform operations, stakeholder engagement, and change management while helping the team scale execution capacity during a period of significant transformation.

Responsibilities

  • Support platform experience activities that make it easier for sellers, partners, and stakeholders to find the right resources, understand what to do next, and engage with enablement platforms confidently.
  • Assist with page readiness, page review, navigation updates, content placement, and experience quality checks across The Sales Hub and related platform experiences.
  • Partner with the Platform Experience Leader to support content organization, taxonomy alignment, journey design, and usability improvements.
  • Help coordinate stakeholder inputs, feedback, and follow-ups to keep platform experience work moving across multiple teams and workstreams.
  • Support adoption and activation activities by helping prepare guidance, communications, enablement materials, and stakeholder resources.
  • Track open experience issues, risks, decisions, and action items to ensure follow-through and visibility for program leadership.
  • Assist with reviewing feedback from sellers, partners, content stakeholders, and support channels to identify common pain points and improvement opportunities.
  • Document repeatable processes, operating guidance, and lessons learned to help scale the platform experience operating model over time.
  • Collaborate with content experience administrators, system administrators, support services, reporting resources, and program leadership to help maintain a connected and consistent experience.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by bringing forward observations, recommended fixes, and practical ideas that improve usability, clarity, and adoption.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms, processes, and ways of working.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to review pages, content placement, and user experience elements for clarity and consistency.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to track multiple tasks, follow up on open items, and keep work moving across stakeholders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize issues, document processes, and provide practical updates.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, evolving environment where priorities may shift and processes may still be forming.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams while also taking ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify gaps, raise issues early, and recommend simple, practical solutions.
  • Interest in digital enablement, sales enablement, content experience, platform operations, user experience, communications, or change management.
  • Basic experience with Microsoft Office, collaboration tools, content platforms, learning platforms, or digital workplace tools preferred.

Compensation:

The target salary range for this position is 70,550 - 104,500 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. The range is based on 'On Target Earnings’ (OTE) representing the total potential earnings, which is the sum of the base salary and potential commission earned when performance targets are achieved. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off (PTO), various Leave options, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s). These offerings are subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. We will provide detailed information about the specific benefits for your region during the recruitment process.

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations.   • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

Frontend

Team & Delivery

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Core Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, .NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework.

  • Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations.

  • Delivery & Test Engineering: Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing.

  • AI Adoption & Technical Leadership: Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries.

  • Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development: Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows.

  • Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance.

  • Technical Debt & Governance: Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints.

  • Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment.

  • Backend Stack: Deep expertise in C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs.

  • Databases: Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures.

  • Cloud & DevOps: Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines.

  • Testing: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools.

  • Artificial Intelligence: Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.
Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

Wati is proudly backed by world-class investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify. As a Premium-tier Partner of Meta, Google, and WhatsApp, we maintain the highest standards of integration and platform excellence.

About the Role:

In this role, you will act as a crucial bridge between data and product strategy: analyze user behavior and product performance, using SQL, visualization tools, and product analytics platforms, to deliver actionable insights that drive product decisions. Your work directly impacts key SaaS metrics like ACV and churn/retention. You will collaborate with product managers, engineers, revenue operations, and executives, requiring strong communication and collaboration skills. The ideal candidate possesses a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and a proactive, independent work ethic, with a proven track record of influencing product roadmaps through data-driven analysis.

What you’ll do:

  1. Generate Insights and Influence data driven decision making. Some example projects: funnel analysis, user segmentation, product feature analysis, pricing optimization.
  2. Experiment Design and hypothesis testing.
  3. Data visualization, dashboard building, self serve dataset building for the stakeholders.
  4. Define and formulate metrics. For example defining success metrics to measure product features or initiatives success.
  5. Storytelling with Data: Translating analytical findings into compelling narratives that resonate with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  6. Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Employing strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to tackle complex product-related challenges.
  7. Closely working with Product Managers on product related projects, and other technical (e.g. Engineering) and non technical stakeholders (e.g. Customer Success, Sales, etc.)
  8. Applying advanced SQL skills for querying databases, as well as utilizing programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis tasks.


What will make you stand out:

  1. Proactive & Independent: Adaptable, eager to learn new skills, and comfortable with ambiguity. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the product based on data analysis.
  2. Strategic Product Thinking & Business Acumen: Ability to translate data into actionable insights, highlighting key takeaways and recommending specific actions. Can understand the business context and can connect data to real-world product challenges.
  3. Communication & Collaboration:
  • Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, Revops and other members within the Data Team.
  • Present complex data in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach to problem-solving. They should be able to identify key areas of inquiry and formulate insightful questions to guide their analysis.

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of experience in product analysis, data analysis, or a related field, demonstrating a track record of using data to drive product strategy and decision-making. Experience in the SaaS industry is preferred.
  2. Excellent SQL skills, experience using DBT for data modeling is a plus.
  3. Expert in the fundamentals of product analytics including building metric trees, experimentation, user activity & retention analytics, funnels & customer segmentation.
  4. Experience in creating impactful data visualizations using tools such as Looker Studio.
  5. Experience working with event based tracking data for web or mobile and hands-on experience with a behavioral analytics tool e.g. Heap, MixPanel, Amplitude etc.
  6. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. (English is a must!)
  7. Working knowledge of Python/R is a plus
